papers.title: Perioperative systemic therapy versus surgery alone for resectable colorectal peritoneal-only metastases (CAIRO6): a randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial
papers.ptype: Clinical Trial, Phase III, Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: Rovers K, Bakkers C, van den Heuvel T, van de Vlasakker V, Kerkhoff T, Nienhuijs S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Data are sparse on the value of perioperative systemic therapy in patients with resectable colorectal peritoneal-only metastases. This trial aimed to compare the efficacy of perioperative systemic therapy versus surgery alone in this population.
METHODS: This randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial was done at all nine Dutch tertiary centres and one Belgian tertiary centre. Eligible patients were aged 18 years or older with a WHO performance status of 0 or 1 and pathologically proven resectable peritoneal-only metastases of a colorectal adenocarcinoma who did not receive systemic therapy for at least 6 months. Enrolled patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to perioperative systemic therapy and cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (CRS-HIPEC; perioperative systemic therapy group) or upfront CRS-HIPEC alone (surgery alone group) using a web-based system with minimisation stratified by previous systemic therapy, synchronous or metachronous peritoneal metastases, peritoneal cancer index 0-10 or 11-20, and mitomycin C-based or oxaliplatin-based HIPEC. At investigator's choice, perioperative systemic therapy comprised either four 3-week neoadjuvant and adjuvant cycles of CAPOX (intravenous oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2 followed by oral capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice per day on days 1-14), six 2-week neoadjuvant and adjuvant cycles of FOLFOX (intravenous oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 with intravenous leucovorin 400 mg/m2, followed by bolus intravenous 5-fluorouracil 400 mg/m2, and continuous intravenous 5-fluorouracil 2400 mg/m2 for 48 h), or six 2-week neoadjuvant cycles of FOLFIRI (intravenous irinotecan 180 mg/m2 with intravenous leucovorin 400 mg/m2, followed by bolus intravenous 5-fluorouracil 400 mg/m2, and continuous intravenous 5-fluorouracil 2400 mg/m2 for 48 h) followed by either four 3-week adjuvant cycles of oral capecitabine (1000 mg/m2 twice per day on days 1-14) or six 2-week adjuvant cycles of 5-fluorouracil and leucovorin (intravenous leucovorin 400 mg/m2, followed by bolus intravenous 5-fluorouracil 400 mg/m2, and continuous intravenous 5-fluorouracil 2400 mg/m2 for 48 h). Intravenous bevacizumab was added to the first three neoadjuvant cycles of CAPOX (7·5 mg/kg) or the first four neoadjuvant cycles of FOLFOX or FOLFIRI (5 mg/kg). The primary outcome was overall survival assessed in a prespecified modified intention-to-treat population, excluding patients who withdrew consent before treatment or violated major eligibility criteria. Major postoperative morbidity was defined as Clavien-Dindo grade 3-5 and assessed up to 90 days postoperatively. Major systemic therapy-related toxicity was defined as Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) grade 3-5 and assessed up to 30 days after its last administration. The Dutch patient organisation for colorectal cancer was involved in the trial design. The trial is registered with Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT02758951) and is active but not recruiting.
FINDINGS: Between June 15, 2017, and April 29, 2024, 1922 patients were screened for eligibility. Of these, 358 patients were enrolled and randomly assigned to perioperative systemic therapy (n=180) or surgery alone (n=178). 351 patients were included in the modified intention-to-treat population (173 patients randomly assigned to perioperative systemic therapy and 178 patients to surgery alone; 181 [52%] male and 170 [48%] female). After a median follow-up of 41 months (IQR 21-62), median overall survival was 44 months (95% CI 30-54) in the perioperative systemic therapy group versus 39 months (95% CI 31-46) in the surgery alone group (hazard ratio [HR] 0·85, 95% CI 0·62-1·15; p=0·28). In 292 patients who underwent macroscopic complete or near complete CRS-HIPEC, major 90-day postoperative morbidity occurred in 49 (36%) of 138 patients in the perioperative systemic therapy group and in 40 (26%) of 154 patients in the surgery alone group. The most common Clavien-Dindo grade 3-4 postoperative adverse events were intra-abdominal abscess (16 [12%] of 138 patients in the perioperative systemic therapy group vs 16 [10%] of 154 patients in the surgery alone group), anastomotic leakage (12 [9%] vs six [4%]), and fascia dehiscence (13 [9%] vs six [4%]). 90-day postoperative mortality occurred in two (1%) patients in the perioperative systemic therapy group (anastomotic leakage and cerebrovascular accident) and in one (1%) patient in the surgery alone group (anastomotic leakage). Major systemic therapy-related toxicity occurred in 92 (57%) of 161 patients who started perioperative systemic therapy. The most common CTCAE grade 3-4 systemic therapy-related adverse events were hypertension (13 [8%] patients), diarrhoea (12 [7%] patients), neutropenia (11 [7%] patients), and thromboembolic events (ten [6%] patients). Systemic therapy-related death occurred in one (1%) patient (hyperglycaemia).
INTERPRETATION: Perioperative systemic therapy cannot be recommended in all patients with resectable colorectal peritoneal-only metastases.
FUNDING: Dutch Cancer Society, F Hoffman-La Roche.

papers.title_zh: 可切除大腸直腸腹膜轉移病人：術前後全身性治療 vs 單純手術之隨機對照試驗（CAIRO6）
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：關於可切除大腸直腸腹膜單純轉移病人使用術前後全身性治療的價值，目前資料稀少。本試驗旨在比較此族群中術前後全身性治療與單純手術的療效。

方法：本隨機、開放標籤、第三期試驗於荷蘭全部九家三級醫學中心及一家比利時三級醫學中心進行。納入條件為年齡18歲以上、WHO表現狀態0或1、病理證實為可切除的大腸直腸腺癌腹膜單純轉移，且至少6個月未接受全身性治療者。病人以1:1隨機分配（採用網路系統、最小化法分層，依先前是否接受全身性治療、同時性或異時性腹膜轉移、腹膜癌指數0-10或11-20、以及mitomycin C或oxaliplatin基礎HIPEC分層）至術前後全身性治療併細胞減量手術加溫熱腹腔化療（CRS-HIPEC，術前後全身性治療組），或單純先行CRS-HIPEC（單純手術組）。依研究者選擇，術前後全身性治療可為：四個週期（每3週）新輔助及輔助CAPOX（靜脈oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2併口服capecitabine 1000 mg/m2每日兩次，第1-14天）；或六個週期（每2週）新輔助及輔助FOLFOX（靜脈oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2併靜脈leucovorin 400 mg/m2，接續靜脈bolus 5-FU 400 mg/m2及持續輸注5-FU 2400 mg/m2達48小時）；或六個週期（每2週）新輔助FOLFIRI（靜脈irinotecan 180 mg/m2併靜脈leucovorin 400 mg/m2，接續靜脈bolus 5-FU 400 mg/m2及持續輸注5-FU 2400 mg/m2達48小時），後接四個週期（每3週）輔助口服capecitabine（1000 mg/m2每日兩次，第1-14天）或六個週期（每2週）輔助5-FU併leucovorin。靜脈bevacizumab加入前三個CAPOX新輔助週期（7.5 mg/kg）或前四個FOLFOX/FOLFIRI新輔助週期（5 mg/kg）。主要結果為預先指定之修正意向治療（modified intention-to-treat）人群中的整體存活，排除治療前撤回同意或違反主要納入條件者。主要術後併發症定義為Clavien-Dindo三至五級，術後90天內評估。主要全身性治療相關毒性定義為CTCAE三至五級，於最後一次給藥後30天內評估。荷蘭大腸直腸癌病友組織參與試驗設計。試驗於Clinicaltrials.gov註冊（NCT02758951），目前仍活躍但未招募。

結果：2017年6月15日至2024年4月29日間，共篩選1922名病人。其中358名病人入選並隨機分配至術前後全身性治療組（n=180）或單純手術組（n=178）。351名病人納入修正意向治療人群（術前後全身性治療組173名、單純手術組178名；181名〔52%〕男性、170名〔48%〕女性）。中位追蹤41個月（IQR 21-62），中位整體存活術前後全身性治療組為44個月（95% CI 30-54），單純手術組為39個月（95% CI 31-46）（風險比〔HR〕0.85，95% CI 0.62-1.15；p=0.28）。在292名接受肉眼完全或近完全CRS-HIPEC切除的病人中，術前後全身性治療組138人中有49人（36%）發生主要90天術後併發症，單純手術組154人中有40人（26%）。最常見的Clavien-Dindo三至四級術後不良事件為腹內膿腫（術前後全身性治療組138人中16人〔12%〕 vs 單純手術組154人中16人〔10%〕）、吻合口洩漏（12人〔9%〕 vs 6人〔4%〕）、以及筋膜裂開（13人〔9%〕 vs 6人〔4%〕）。90天術後死亡率：術前後全身性治療組2人（1%，吻合口洩漏及腦血管意外），單純手術組1人（1%，吻合口洩漏）。161名開始術前後全身性治療者中，92人（57%）發生主要全身性治療相關毒性。最常見CTCAE三至四級全身性治療相關不良事件為高血壓（13人〔8%〕）、腹瀉（12人〔7%〕）、神經性白血球低下（11人〔7%〕）及血栓栓塞事件（10人〔6%〕）。1名病人（1%）發生全身性治療相關死亡（高血糖）。

詮釋：術前後全身性治療不應建議用於所有可切除大腸直腸腹膜單純轉移病人。

經費來源：荷蘭癌症協會、F Hoffman-La Roche。

papers.title: ELECLA trial: final results of perioperative chemotherapy with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin in mismatch repair proficient locally advanced colon cancer
papers.authors: Arredondo J, Aliseda D, Castañón C, Pastor E, Tejedor P, Muinelo M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The current standard of care for resectable locally advanced colon cancer (LACC) is based on upfront surgery followed by adjuvant chemotherapy (AC). This study aimed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) in this setting.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: ELECLA is a multicenter, randomized, open-label, phase II controlled trial conducted across 12 hospitals in Spain between March 2017 and June 2024. This report presents the results of a preplanned interim analysis conducted after early termination of recruitment following the loss of clinical equipoise. Patients with radiologically defined LACC (T3 > 5 mm/T4, any N, and M0) and proficient mismatch repair status, were randomly assigned at a 1:1 ratio to receive either NAC (three cycles of CAPOX or five of FOLFOX), surgery, and AC (investigational group) or upfront surgery followed by AC (control group). The primary endpoint was 2-year disease-free survival.
RESULTS: A total of 120 patients were included. The NAC completion rate was 94.2%, with a nonsignificant trend toward a reduced surgical complication rate compared with controls (17.3% versus 22.1%; P = 0.52). In the investigational group, a favorable radiologic tumor downstaging was achieved, with a tumor volume reduction of 65.4% (P < 0.001), and a tumor regression grading of 0-2 in 51.2% of assessable patients. An R0 resection was achieved in all patients within the NAC group. A relevant reduction in classical histological adverse prognostic features, including lymphatic invasion (21.5% versus 44.1%; P = 0.009), tumor budding (23.3% versus 58.5%; P = 0.002), and incomplete resections (0% versus 7.4%; P = 0.068) was observed in the NAC group. The 2-year disease-free survival rate was 88.9% [95% confidence interval (CI) 75.2% to 95.2%] in the intervention group and 83.3% (95% CI 70.9% to 90.7%) in the control group (P = 0.34).
CONCLUSION: NAC is safe, feasible, and associated with improved tumor downstaging and favorable pathologic features without increased perioperative morbidity. These findings support the use of NAC as a safe and efficient therapeutic option in patients with LACC.

papers.title_zh: ELECLA試驗：錯配修復功能正常（pMMR）局部進展期大腸癌患者接受含fluoropyrimidine及oxaliplatin之圍術期化療——最終結果
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：目前可切除局部進展期大腸癌（LACC）的標準治療為先行手術後再輔助化療（AC）。本研究旨在評估此情境下新輔助化療（NAC）的安全性與療效。

病人與方法：ELECLA是一項在西班牙12家醫院進行的多中心、隨機、開放標籤第二期對照試驗，收案期間為2017年3月至2024年6月。本報告呈現的是因失去臨床均等性而提前終止收案後，預先規劃的中期分析結果。放射學定義之LACC患者（T3>5mm/T4，任何N，M0），且錯配修復功能正常，以1:1比例隨機分配至NAC組（3個療程CAPOX或5個療程FOLFOX後手術，再接受AC，為試驗組）或直接手術後接受AC（對照組）。主要終點為2年無病生存率（DFS）。

結果：共納入120名患者。NAC完成率為94.2%，手術併發症發生率有非顯著下降趨勢（試驗組17.3% vs 對照組22.1%；P=0.52）。試驗組達成良好的放射學腫瘤降期，腫瘤體積縮小65.4%（P<0.001），可評估患者中51.2%達到腫瘤退縮分級（TRG）0-2級。NAC組所有患者均達成R0切除。NAC組在傳統病理不良預後特徵上有顯著改善，包括淋巴管侵犯（21.5% vs 44.1%；P=0.009）、腫瘤芽生（23.3% vs 58.5%；P=0.002）以及不完全切除（0% vs 7.4%；P=0.068）。試驗組2年DFS為88.9%（95%信賴區間75.2%-95.2%），對照組為83.3%（95%信賴區間70.9%-90.7%）（P=0.34）。

結論：NAC安全、可行，且與腫瘤降期改善及有利的病理特徵相關，未增加圍術期併發症。此結果支持將NAC作為LACC患者安全且有效的治療選項。

papers.title: Endoscopic negative-pressure therapy for anastomotic leaks after upper gastrointestinal surgery: systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Gómez S, Garrido M, Molina C, Cortijo S, Cuellar E, Herrero E
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: UGI anastomotic leaks are severe postoperative complications associated with substantial morbidity, mortality, and prolonged hospitalization. EVT is a minimally invasive alternative to conventional approaches, but evidence has not been comprehensively synthesized.
METHODS: This systematic review and meta-analysis was reported in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 statement. Observational studies (January 2015-January 2025) identified in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane, and LILACS. Adults with UGI anastomotic leaks treated with EVT were eligible. Random-effects models pooled proportions using the Freeman-Tukey double-arcsine transformation; sensitivity analyses used a logit transformation. Pre-specified subgroup analyses stratified by surgical indication (oncologic, bariatric, mixed), leak location (intrathoracic vs intra-abdominal), and risk of bias. Risk of bias was appraised using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) critical appraisal checklist for case series and certainty of evidence with GRADE.
RESULTS: Thirty-one studies (n = 767) were included. The pooled clinical success was 87% (95% CI, 82-91%) and remained high in sensitivity analyses (84-89%). No material differences were observed across oncologic, bariatric, or mixed series. Intrathoracic leaks showed lower success than intra-abdominal leaks (79 vs 95%). Thirty-day mortality was 7%, primarily in complex clinical contexts. Heterogeneity was substantial, and small-study effects were suspected. Overall certainty of evidence was rated low owing to observational design and risk of bias.
CONCLUSIONS: Across observational studies, EVT achieved high clinical success for UGI anastomotic leaks with low short-term mortality. Prospective cohorts and randomized trials are needed to refine indications, identify predictors of response, and assess cost-effectiveness.

papers.title_zh: 上消化道手術後吻合口洩漏之內視鏡負壓治療（EVT）：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：上消化道（UGI）吻合口洩漏是嚴重的術後併發症，伴隨顯著的病摧率、死亡率及住院時間延長。EVT是傳統治療方式之外的微創替代方案，但目前證據尚未被全面整合。方法：本系統性回顧與統合分析依循PRISMA 2020聲明撰寫。納入PubMed、Embase、Cochrane及LILACS資料庫中2015年1月至2025年1月間發表之觀察性研究。納入接受EVT治療的成人UGI吻合口洩漏病人。使用隨機效應模型，以Freeman-Tukey雙重反正弦轉換法合併比例；敏感性分析採用logit轉換法。預先設定的次群組分析依手術指徵（腫瘤性、減重性、混合性）、洩漏位置（胸內vs腹內）及偏誤風險分層。偏誤風險以Joanna Briggs Institute（JBI）病例系列評估清單評估，證據確定性以GRADE評估。結果：共納入31篇研究（n=767）。合併臨床成功率為87%（95% CI，82-91%），敏感性分析中仍維持高水準（84-89%）。腫瘤性、減重性及混合性系列間未觀察到明顯差異。胸內洩漏的成功率低於腹內洩漏（79% vs 95%）。30天死亡率為7%，主要發生於複雜臨床情境。異質性顯著，且疑似存在小型研究效應。由於觀察性研究設計及偏誤風險，整體證據確定性評為低。結論：在觀察性研究中，EVT對UGI吻合口洩漏達成高臨床成功率，且短期死亡率低。仍需前瞻性世代研究及隨機對照試驗以精進治療指徵、找出反應預測因子並評估成本效益。
papers.score_reason: 證據來自觀察性研究、GRADE評為低確定性，且族群為上消化道（食道/減重手術）而非結直腸，對台灣大腸直腸外科臨床實用性有限。

papers.title: Short-term surgical outcomes of robotic-assisted versus laparoscopic ileal pouch-anal anastomosis (IPAA): a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Burns J, Abraham A, Emile S, Sipe S, Lopez C, Wagner L
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Laparoscopic and robotic-assisted approaches are increasingly used for ileal pouch-anal anastomosis (IPAA) after restorative proctocolectomy, yet direct comparisons of short-term outcomes are limited. This systematic review compared the collective short-term outcomes of laparoscopic and robotic-assisted IPAA.
METHODS: A PRISMA-compliant systematic review of PubMed, Scopus, and Cochrane Library was performed (January 2000-June 2025) to identify studies comparing robotic-assisted and laparoscopic IPAA. The primary outcome was 30-day complications and conversion to open surgery. Pairwise meta-analyses and random-effects meta-regression were conducted. The risk of bias was assessed using ROBINS-1 tool; evidence certainty was examined using GRADE.
RESULTS: 8 cohort studies, comprising 1861 patients, were included. 1241 patients (66.7%) underwent laparoscopic IPAA, 620 (33.3%) underwent robotic-assisted IPAA. There were no significant differences in the odds of total (OR 0.97, 95%CI 0.66, 1.41, p = 0.855) or major complications (OR 1.11, 95%CI 0.81, 1.53, p = 0.511). Odds of ileus, small bowel obstruction, and anastomotic leak were comparable. Robotic-assisted IPAA was associated with significantly fewer conversions to open surgery (OR 0.25, 95%CI 0.08, 0.77, p = 0.015) but longer operative times (WMD 24.97, 95%CI 2.09, 47.85, p = 0.032). Blood loss and intraoperative complications did not significantly differ. Meta-regression showed the conversion benefit of robotic IPAA was more pronounced in male patients and those with higher ASA, ulcerative colitis, and 3-stage IPAA.
CONCLUSIONS: Robotic-assisted and laparoscopic IPAA have comparable short-term complication rates, with robotic-assisted surgery offering significantly lower risk of conversion but longer operative times. These findings confirm robotic-assisted IPAA is an acceptable alternative to laparoscopic IPAA; however, interpretation should be cautious given the observational design of the studies and overall low certainty of evidence. Surgeon expertise in technique and resource availability will influence operative approach.

papers.title_zh: 機器人輔助與腹腔鏡迴腸儲袋肛門吻合術（IPAA）短期手術結果比較：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：腹腔鏡與機器人輔助手術在恢復性全大腸切除術後的迴腸儲袋肛門吻合術（IPAA）中應用日增，然而兩者短期結果的直接比較仍有限。本系統性回顧比較腹腔鏡與機器人輔助IPAA之整體短期結果。方法：依PRISMA準則系統性搜尋PubMed、Scopus及Cochrane Library資料庫（2000年1月至2025年6月），納入比較機器人輔助與腹腔鏡IPAA之研究。主要結果為30天併發症與轉開腹率。進行配對統合分析與隨機效應meta-regression。以ROBINS-1工具評估偏誤風險，以GRADE系統評估證據確定性。結果：共納入8篇世代研究，共1861名病人。1241名（66.7%）接受腹腔鏡IPAA，620名（33.3%）接受機器人輔助IPAA。總併發症（OR 0.97，95%CI 0.66-1.41，p=0.855）或主要併發症（OR 1.11，95%CI 0.81-1.53，p=0.511）之發生率無顯著差異。腸阻塞、小腸阻塞與吻合口漏發生率相近。機器人輔助IPAA之轉開腹率顯著較低（OR 0.25，95%CI 0.08-0.77，p=0.015），但手術時間較長（加權平均差 24.97分鐘，95%CI 2.09-47.85，p=0.032）。出血量與術中併發症無顯著差異。Meta-regression顯示機器人IPAA之轉開腹優勢在男性病人、較高ASA分級、潰瘍性結腸炎與三階段IPAA病人中更為明顯。結論：機器人輔助與腹腔鏡IPAA之短期併發症率相當，機器人輔助手術有顯著較低之轉開腹風險，但手術時間較長。此結果支持機器人輔助IPAA為腹腔鏡IPAA之可接受替代方案；然而由於研究皆為觀察性設計且整體證據確定性偏低，詮釋應謹慎。外科醫師之技術熟練度與資源可及性將影響手術方式之選擇。

papers.title: Sequencing Ablation and Systemic Therapy in Colorectal Liver Oligometastases: An Upfront versus Delayed Approach Nationwide Analysis
papers.authors: Li J, Pang C, Li H, Liu G, Xie X, Zhang D
papers.abstract: Background The optimal sequencing of thermal ablation relative to systemic therapy for colorectal liver oligometastases (CLOM) remains controversial, with limited evidence to guide treatment planning. Purpose To compare the long-term survival outcomes of patients with CLOM receiving upfront ablation (UA) versus delayed ablation (DA) in combination with systemic therapies. Materials and Methods Patients with five or fewer CLOM (maximum lesion diameter, <5 cm) from 21 Chinese tertiary hospitals were included in this multicenter cohort study (October 2009 to March 2024). Patients were categorized into UA and DA groups based on the decisions of multidisciplinary teams. UA consisted of microwave ablation followed by adjuvant systemic therapy administered within 1 month. DA involved neoadjuvant systemic therapy (delivered over 2-3 months) combined with subsequent ablation. The primary outcome was progression-free survival (PFS), and a secondary outcome was overall survival (OS), both assessed using multivariable-adjusted Cox regression analysis and Kaplan-Meier survival curves. Procedure-related complication rates were analyzed. Sensitivity analyses, including propensity score matching, inverse probability treatment weighting, and overlap weighting, were performed to adjust for confounders. Results A total of 1047 patients were included (DA group [n = 536]: mean age, 57.53 years ± 10.99 [SD]; 381 male; UA group [n = 511]: mean age, 60.96 years ± 11.77; 356 male). The follow-up duration was 15 years. Median PFS (1.48 vs 0.98 years; hazard ratio [HR], 0.70 [95% CI: 0.61, 0.81]; P < .001) and OS (6.94 vs 4.74 years; HR, 0.70 [95% CI: 0.57, 0.87]; P = .001) were longer in the UA group compared with the DA group. Sensitivity analyses confirmed robustness (PFS HR, 0.67-0.80; OS HR, 0.73-0.77). UA benefits persisted across subgroups, including synchronous metastases (HR, 0.67 [95% CI: 0.55, 0.81]; P = .04) and lesions smaller than 3 cm (HR, 0.68 [95% CI: 0.58, 0.80]; P = .005). Elevated carcinoembryonic antigen levels (≥5 µg/L) and multiple metastases independently predicted worse survival (HR, 1.30 and 1.47, respectively; P < .001 for both). Conclusion UA combined with systemic therapy significantly improved long-term survival compared with DA, with similar complication rates. © RSNA, 2026 Supplemental material is available for this article. See also the editorial by Woodrum in this issue.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌肝寡轉移病人中消融術與全身治療之先後順序：先消融versus延遲消融之全國性分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：對於大腸直腸癌肝寡轉移（CLOM）病人，熱消融術相對於全身治療的最佳施行順序仍具爭議，指引證據有限。目的：比較CLOM病人接受先消融（UA）與延遲消融（DA）併用全身治療後之長期存活結果。方法：本多中心世代研究納入2009年10月至2024年3月間，來自中國21家三級醫院、肝轉移病灶數≤5顆（最大病灶直徑<5cm）之病人。病人依多學科團隊（MDT）決策分為UA組與DA組。UA為先進行微波消融，於1個月內接續輔助性全身治療；DA為先給予新輔助全身治療（2-3個月），再接續消融。主要結果為無進展存活期（PFS），次要結果為總體存活期（OS），皆以多變項校正Cox回歸分析與Kaplan-Meier存活曲線評估。另分析與消融相關之併發症發生率。並進行敏感性分析，包括傾向分數配對、逆機率治療加權與重疊加權以校正干擾因子。結果：共納入1047名病人（DA組n=536：平均年齡57.53±10.99歲，男性381人；UA組n=511：平均年齡60.96±11.77歲，男性356人）。追蹤期間為15年。UA組之PFS（1.48 vs 0.98年；HR 0.70 [95% CI: 0.61, 0.81]；P<.001）與OS（6.94 vs 4.74年；HR 0.70 [95% CI: 0.57, 0.87]；P=.001）皆優於DA組。敏感性分析證實結果穩健（PFS HR 0.67-0.80；OS HR 0.73-0.77）。UA之效益在次群組中持續存在，包括同時性轉移（HR 0.67 [95% CI: 0.55, 0.81]；P=.04）與病灶小於3cm者（HR 0.68 [95% CI: 0.58, 0.80]；P=.005）。癌胚抗原（CEA）升高（≥5 µg/L）與多發轉移為存活較差之獨立預測因子（HR分別為1.30與1.47，P<.001）。結論：UA併用全身治療相較於DA顯著改善長期存活，且併發症發生率相近。

papers.title: Single-port robotic versus laparoscopic transanal minimally invasive surgery (TAMIS) for rectal neoplasms: a first comparative analysis of surgical efficiency and clinical outcomes
papers.authors: Kim I, Lee Y, Mun J, Bae J, Yoo N, Kye B
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Single-port (SP) robotic platform has recently been applied to transanal minimally invasive surgery (TAMIS). However, comparative data with conventional TAMIS performed using laparoscopic instruments remain limited. This study aimed to evaluate the technical feasibility and short-term outcomes of SP robotic TAMIS compared to laparoscopic TAMIS.
METHODS: Multi-institutional retrospective cohort study of 108 patients (SPR n = 34, LAP n = 74) undergoing TAMIS for rectal neoplasms from January 2016 to September 2025. Patients with benign rectal neoplasms, clinical stage T1N0 with well to moderately differentiated tumor, or low-risk feature tumors were included. Primary outcome was operative feasibility (operative time, full-thickness excision, intraoperative complications). Secondary outcomes included postoperative complications, length of stay (LOS), and pathological safety.
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups. The distance from anal verge was 6.42 ± 2.45 in the SP robotic group and 7.37 ± 2.53 in the LAP group (p = 0.155). Mean operative time was significantly shorter in the SPR groups (44.6 ± 25.1 min vs. 57.5 ± 28.7 min, p = 0.026). All patients achieved full-thickness resection with negative margins. No intraoperative complications occurred in either group. The length of hospital stay was significantly shorter in SPR groups (1.47 ± 0.99 vs. 2.51 ± 1.13 days, p < 0.001). Comparative video analysis demonstrated superior articulation and visualization in narrow anal canal access in the SPR approach.
CONCLUSIONS: Single-port robotic TAMIS demonstrates comparable technical feasibility and clinical outcomes to conventional TAMIS while offering potential perioperative advantages including shorter operative time and shorter hospital stay with pathological safety.

papers.title: Is Fusobacterium nucleatum the key mediator between oral infections and systemic diseases? Mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications
papers.authors: Siddarth Ragunagam G, Anbarasu A, Kodiveri Muthukaliannan G
papers.abstract: Fusobacterium nucleatum has emerged as a pathobiont that associates oral dysbiosis with systemic diseases through coaggregation, hematogenous dissemination, and immune modulation. This review provides molecular insights through which they are involved in systemic diseases such as colorectal cancer, adverse pregnancy outcomes, cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative disorders, and diabetes mellitus. Key virulence factors include the adhesins of FadA, Fap2, and RadD, lipopolysaccharides, and outer membrane vesicles, which mediate epithelial invasion and endothelial permeafbility and facilitate immune suppression through TLR4-NF-κB, β-catenin/Wnt, and MAPK signaling pathways. These interactions result in impaired tissue homeostasis, propagate chronic inflammation, and promote oncogenic and metabolic modulation. Systemic pleiotropy of F. nucleatum is further substantiated by its involvement in chemoresistance, placental dysfunction, vascular inflammation, and neuronal injury, substantiating its systemic pleiotropy. Emerging therapeutic strategies, such as blocking adhesins, neutralizing outer membrane vesicles, microbiome manipulation, and using CRISPR-based clearance, provide precision techniques for mitigating diseases. Therefore, this review identifies F. nucleatum as the primary microbial mediator of oral-systemic pathology and its translational significance in the development of targeted antimicrobial and host-directed therapies.

papers.abstract_zh: Fusobacterium nucleatum已成為一種病原共生菌（pathobiont），透過共聚集作用、血行性擴散及免疫調節，將口腔菌群失衡與全身性疾病相連結。本綜述提供分子層面的洞見，說明其如何參與大腸直腸癌、不良妊娠結果、心血管疾病、神經退化性疾病及糖尿病等全身性疾病。關鍵毒力因子包括黏附素FadA、Fap2、RadD，脂多醣（lipopolysaccharides），以及外膜囊泡（outer membrane vesicles），這些因子介導上皮侵入與內皮通透性增加，並透過TLR4-NF-κB、β-catenin/Wnt及MAPK訊號路徑促進免疫抑制。這些交互作用導致組織恆定性受損、慢性發炎持續，並促進致癌性與代謝調控異常。F. nucleatum的全身性多效性（systemic pleiotropy）進一步表現於其參與化療抗藥性、胎盤功能障礙、血管發炎及神經元損傷。新興治療策略，如阻斷黏附素、中和外膜囊泡、微生物群調控、以及以CRISPR為基礎的清除技術，提供了緩解疾病的精準方法。因此，本綜述將F. nucleatum定位為口腔-全身病理學的主要微生物中介者，並闡述其在開發靶向抗菌與宿主導向治療上的轉譯意義。

papers.title: Emergence of invasive Escherichia coli pathobionts in gut microbiome promotes cancer stemness via targeting Hippo pathways
papers.authors: Yu L, Wei S, Lin B, Li Y, Liao Y, Peng Y
papers.abstract: Growing evidence suggests a pivotal role of the microbiome in tumorigenesis, extending beyond genetics. Apc(Min/+) mice exhibit reduced tumor load when housed in germ-free conditions. Nevertheless, how genetic factors shape microbiota and how dysbiosis fits into the genetic paradigm of intestinal carcinogenesis remain elusive. Epithelial stemness is regulated by Wnt/Apc/β-catenin pathway, whereas Apc mutations and Hippo signaling are associated with tumor growth. Invasive pathobionts emerge from microbiota as a result of epithelial barrier dysfunction. We hypothesize that the emergence of invasive pathobionts and dysbiosis of epithelial microbiota contribute to increased cancer stemness. The epithelial and fecal microbiota are longitudinally monitored in Apc(Min/+) and wild-type littermates born to wild-type surrogate dams. Segregation of epithelial microbiota between Apc(Min/+) and wild-type mice was observed as early as eight weeks after birth, whereas fecal microbiota diverged at 20 weeks of age. Epithelial dysbiosis and barrier defects were observed in Apc(Min/+) mice, characterized by intraepithelial Escherichia coli with invasive features. While antibiotic treatment reduced cancer burden, invasive E. coli infection promoted tumorsphere formation. Higher expression of Vgll3 and Tead4 (Hippo effectors) and Cd44 (a cancer stemness marker) was observed in bacteria-infected tumorspheres. Mechanistically, bacteria augmented epithelial clonogenicity by enhancing VGLL3/TEAD4-mediated CD44 promoter activity. Invasive E. coli genetic signatures were verified in 86% of human colorectal carcinoma specimens, and a positive correlation with TEAD4 expression was observed. In conclusion, Apc mutation drives the expansion of invasive pathobionts to promote cancer stemness via a VGLL3/TEAD4/CD44 axis. Bacteria-targeting interventions could be an alternative strategy for patients with hereditary tumors.

papers.title: Differences in Cascade Genetic Testing Among Families With Hereditary Cancer Risk
papers.authors: Namey E, Horton C, Dudley B, Carraway C, Komala T, Milliard C
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Performing germline genetic testing of family members following the identification of an individual with a pathogenic variant in a cancer predisposition gene, a process known as cascade testing, is a critical step in maximizing the preventive benefit of genetic testing for hereditary cancer.
OBJECTIVE: To determine how often family members undergo cascade testing and to evaluate demographic, socioeconomic, and clinical factors associated with this process.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This retrospective cross-sectional study analyzed demographics, cancer history, genetic test results, and cascade testing data from probands who underwent multigene panel testing between December 2016 and August 2020 at a single diagnostic laboratory. The study cohort included probands found to have a pathogenic or likely pathogenic variant (P/LPV) in Lynch syndrome (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2, or EPCAM) or hereditary breast and ovarian cancer (ATM, BRCA1, BRCA2, CHEK2, or PALB2) genes. Statistical analyses were conducted between June 2023 and March 2025.
EXPOSURE: Identification of a P/LPV in a cancer predisposition gene.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Variables assessed included proband age, sex, race and ethnicity, socioeconomic status (SES), availability of free testing for family members, cancer history, type of test ordered, and clinician credentials. Differences in cascade testing rates were calculated via 2-sided χ2 test.
RESULTS: Of 22 932 probands (18 949 [81.38%] female; mean [SD] age at testing. 51.6 [14.5] years), 5559 (24.24%) had at least 1 family member who underwent cascade testing. Higher rates of cascade testing were seen in individuals aged 40 to 79 years compared with those aged 20 to 39 years (age 40-59 years: 2587 of 10 420 probands [24.83%]; P < .001; age 60-79 years: 1960 of 6869 probands [28.53%]; P < .001; age ≥80 years: 129 of 462 probands [27.92%]; P < .001), women (4740 of 18 948 female probands [25.02%] vs 817 of 3963 male probands [20.62%]; P < .001), non-Hispanic White individuals (3762 of 13 834 probands [27.19%]), those with a personal cancer history vs those without (4712 of 16 674 probands [39.43%] vs 847 of 6261 probands [15.64%]; P < .001), and those whose care involved genetic counselors vs those whose did not (3614 of 13 847 probands [26.10%] vs 1948 of 9088 probands [21.43%]; P < .001). People with BRCA1 or BRCA2 variants had higher cascade testing rates compared with those with ATM, CHEK2, or PALB2 variants (2614 of 9699 probands [26.95%] vs 2015 of 8973 probands [22.46%]; P < .001). Several disparities were identified, including lower rates of cascade testing among male probands and probands from racial or ethnic minority groups compared with non-Hispanic White probands (227 of 1406 African American or Black probands [16.15%]; P < .001; 175 of 875 Asian probands [20.00%]; P < .001; 319 of 1616 Hispanic probands [19.74%]; P < .001; 17 of 146 Middle Eastern probands [11.64%]; P < .001). SES had minimal associations with testing rates, and free family testing was not associated with boosting participation.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this retrospective cross-sectional study, cascade testing was underused, especially among specific demographic groups, with clinical and cultural factors appearing to play a larger role than financial barriers. These findings may guide efforts to address barriers preventing wider uptake of cascade testing and improve cancer prevention efforts, particularly among racial and ethnic minority groups.

papers.title_zh: 遺傳性癌症風險家族中連鎖基因檢測（cascade testing）的差異
papers.abstract_zh: 重要性：在確認個案帶有癌症易感基因的致病變異後，對其家族成員進行生殖細胞基因檢測（稱為連鎖檢測，cascade testing）是最大化遺傳性癌症基因檢測預防效益的關鍵步驟。目的：評估家族成員接受連鎖檢測的頻率，並探討與此過程相關的人口學、社經與臨床因子。設計、場域與參與者：本回溯性橫斷面研究分析了2016年12月至2020年8月間於單一診斷實驗室接受多基因套組檢測的proband（首發個案）的人口學、癌症病史、基因檢測結果及連鎖檢測資料。研究族群納入帶有Lynch症候群（MLH1、MSH2、MSH6、PMS2或EPCAM）或遺傳性乳癌卵巢癌（HBOC）（ATM、BRCA1、BRCA2、CHEK2或PALB2）基因致病或疑似致病變異（P/LPV）之probands。統計分析於2023年6月至2025年3月間進行。暴露：於癌症易感基因中確認P/LPV。主要結果與測量：評估變項包括proband年齡、性別、種族與族裔、社經地位（SES）、家族成員是否有免費檢測、癌症病史、檢測類型及臨床人員資格。連鎖檢測率差異以雙尾χ2檢定計算。結果：22,932名probands中（18,949名〔81.38%〕為女性；檢測時平均年齡51.6歲，SD 14.5歲），5,559名（24.24%）至少有1位家族成員接受連鎖檢測。連鎖檢測率較高者為：年齡40-79歲者（相較20-39歲）（40-59歲：10,420名中2,587名〔24.83%〕，P<.001；60-79歲：6,869名中1,960名〔28.53%〕，P<.001；≥80歲：462名中129名〔27.92%〕，P<.001）、女性（18,948名女性proband中4,740名〔25.02%〕 vs 3,963名男性proband中817名〔20.62%〕，P<.001）、非西語裔白人（13,834名中3,762名〔27.19%〕）、有個人癌症病史者（相較無病史者）（16,674名中4,712名〔39.43%〕 vs 6,261名中847名〔15.64%〕，P<.001），以及有遺傳諮詢師參與照護者（相較無者）（13,847名中3,614名〔26.10%〕 vs 9,088名中1,948名〔21.43%〕，P<.001）。帶有BRCA1或BRCA2變異者，其連鎖檢測率高於帶有ATM、CHEK2或PALB2變異者（9,699名中2,614名〔26.95%〕 vs 8,973名中2,015名〔22.46%〕，P<.001）。研究發現多項差異，包括男性proband及來自種族或族裔少數群體之proband，其連鎖檢測率低於非西語裔白人proband（1,406名非裔或黑人proband中227名〔16.15%〕，P<.001；875名亞裔proband中175名〔20.00%〕，P<.001；1,616名西語裔proband中319名〔19.74%〕，P<.001；146名中東裔proband中17名〔11.64%〕，P<.001）。SES與檢測率關聯甚微，家族免費檢測亦未提升參與率。結論與相關性：在此回溯性橫斷面研究中，連鎖檢測整體使用率偏低，特定人口群體尤為明顯，臨床與文化因素似乎比財務障礙扮演更大角色。此發現可指引未來努力方向，以解決阻礙連鎖檢測普及之障礙，並改善癌症預防，尤其針對種族與族裔少數群體。

papers.title: Clinical Diagnosis Codes Identify Patients Unlikely to Receive Orders for Fecal Immunochemical Tests
papers.journal_full: Cancer control : journal of the Moffitt Cancer Center
papers.authors: Li A, Burns S, Martinez D, Wang P, Aggarwal S, Potter M
papers.abstract: IntroductionAutomated colorectal cancer (CRC) screening programs often invite all age-eligible patients for fecal immunochemical testing (FIT), but providers may defer screening in clinically complex patients. However, such nuanced decisions are not captured by most automated systems. We evaluated whether International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision (ICD-10) codes are associated with variations in FIT ordering patterns beyond age-based outreach criteria.MethodsIn a retrospective observational study of 15,020 screening-eligible patients aged 50-75, we compared the frequency of ICD-10 codes between patients with and without a FIT order. We repeated the analysis restricted to those with a Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI)<5.ResultsOverall, 4,833 (32.2%) patients did not have a FIT order. Of the 1,215 ICD-10 codes examined, 96 were significantly associated with the absence of a FIT order (p<0.05). These codes frequently indicated digestive diseases (e.g., colonic neoplasm, diverticular disease), advanced comorbidities (e.g., frailty, paralysis), and acute conditions (e.g., fractures, severe infections). Among the patients with CCI<5, 41 codes were associated with the absence of a FIT order (p<0.05), such as heart failure and chronic kidney disease.ConclusionScreening-eligible patients without a FIT order were more likely to have ICD-10 codes reflecting digestive diseases, chronic comorbidities, and acute conditions. These findings demonstrate that specific diagnostic profiles are associated with real-world FIT ordering patterns, highlighting the need for further investigation into how comorbidities and competing clinical priorities relate to CRC screening decisions.

papers.title_zh: 臨床診斷碼可識別不易收到糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）醫囑的病人
papers.abstract_zh: 前言：自動化大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢計畫通常會邀請所有符合年齡條件的病人接受糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT），但臨床醫師可能會在臨床狀況複雜的病人身上延後篩檢。然而，這類細緻的決策並未被大多數自動化系統所捕捉。我們評估國際疾病分類第十版（ICD-10）診斷碼是否與超出年齡導向篩檢邀請標準之外的FIT開單模式變異有關。方法：在一項納入15,020名50-75歲符合篩檢資格病人的回溯性觀察研究中，我們比較了有無FIT醫囑病人之間ICD-10診斷碼的出現頻率。我們另外針對Charlson共病指數（CCI）<5的病人重複進行此分析。結果：整體而言，4,833名（32.2%）病人未收到FIT醫囑。在檢視的1,215個ICD-10診斷碼中，96個與未收到FIT醫囑顯著相關（p<0.05）。這些診斷碼多屬消化系統疾病（例如大腸新生物、大腸憩室疾病）、進階共病（例如衰弱、癱瘓）與急性狀況（例如骨折、嚴重感染）。在CCI<5的病人中，有41個診斷碼與未收到FIT醫囑相關，例如心臟衰竭與慢性腎臟病。結論：符合篩檢資格但未收到FIT醫囑的病人，較可能帶有反映消化系統疾病、慢性共病與急性狀況的ICD-10診斷碼。這些發現顯示特定診斷特徵與真實世界FIT開單模式相關，突顯出需進一步研究共病與競爭性臨床優先事項如何影響CRC篩檢決策。

papers.title: CURE: a phase-based therapeutic framework for chronic inflammation
papers.authors: Kurzen N, Weißinger S, Kurzen H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Chronic inflammation represents a central mechanism underlying the persistence of immune-mediated diseases. Unlike acute inflammation, which resolves through coordinated regulatory checkpoints and active resolution programs, chronic inflammation stabilizes in pathological states maintained by cytokine redundancy, tissue-resident immune memory, and self-reinforcing feedback loops that resist termination.
CONCEPTUAL FRAMEWORK: Here, we introduce the CURE framework (CONTROL - UNLOAD and RESET - EQUILIBRATE), a phase-based therapeutic model grounded in systems immunology and nonlinear dynamics. The acronym is used as a mnemonic for the proposed therapeutic sequence and does not imply curative eradication of chronic inflammatory disease. Rather, the framework addresses durable disease control, relapse prevention, and stabilization of functional remission. CURE is proposed as a conceptual, phase-based framework that interprets treatment as dependent on the cumulative intensity and duration of anti-inflammatory therapeutic exposure across three clinically relevant phases. Within this hypothesis, CONTROL refers to sufficiently intensive induction therapy intended to suppress self-sustaining inflammatory circuits and potentially cross clinically relevant inflammatory thresholds. UNLOAD and RESET describe a structured, guided de-escalation phase that consolidates remission while restoring endogenous resolution mechanisms. EQUILIBRATE represents proactive, low-amplitude maintenance aimed at stabilizing long-term immune equilibrium and preventing relapse.
SYSTEMS PERSPECTIVE AND EVIDENCE SYNTHESIS: From a complex systems perspective, durable disease control may depend not solely on dose selection but also on whether therapeutic exposure is sufficient to suppress feedback-driven immune networks below clinically relevant thresholds. The CURE framework integrates mechanistic and clinical evidence across multiple immune-mediated conditions-including atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, inflammatory bowel disease, and rheumatoid arthritis-to illustrate shared immunodynamic principles underlying durable disease control.
CONCLUSIONS: By aligning therapeutic intensity with the dynamic state of the immune system, CURE may provide a transferable, mechanism-oriented framework for personalized intervention in chronic inflammation. It reframes disease management from reactive symptom driven suppression toward proactive, phase-specific immune stabilization. It further offers a common conceptual language across specialties, supporting functional remission, relapse prevention, and long-term tissue integrity.
papers.title_zh: CURE：慢性發炎的階段性治療框架
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：慢性發炎是免疫介導疾病持續存在的核心機制。與急性發炎不同，急性發炎透過協調的調節檢查點與主動消退程序而緩解，慢性發炎則因細胞因子冗餘、組織駐留免疫記憶，以及抗拒終止的自我強化回饋迴路，而穩定於病理狀態。

概念框架：本文提出 CURE 框架（CONTROL 控制 - UNLOAD and RESET 卸載與重置 - EQUILIBRATE 平衡），這是一個立基於系統免疫學與非線性動力學的階段性治療模型。此縮寫僅作為所提治療順序的記憶輔助，並不暗示慢性發炎疾病能被治癒根除。相反地，此框架著重於持久的疾病控制、預防復發，以及功能性緩解的穩定化。CURE 被提出為一個概念性、階段性的框架，將治療視為取決於三個臨床相關階段中抗發炎治療暴露的累積強度與持續時間。在此假說中，CONTROL 指足夠強度的誘導治療，目的在抑制自我維持的發炎迴路，並可能跨越具臨床意義的發炎閾值；UNLOAD 與 RESET 描述一個結構化、引導式的降階階段，用以鞏固緩解並恢復內生性的消退機制；EQUILIBRATE 則代表主動、低強度的維持治療，旨在穩定長期免疫平衡並預防復發。

系統觀點與證據綜合：從複雜系統的觀點來看，持久的疾病控制可能不僅取決於劑量選擇，也取決於治療暴露是否足以將回饋驅動的免疫網絡抑制到具臨床意義的閾值以下。CURE 框架整合了多種免疫介導疾病（包括異位性皮膚炎、乾癬、發炎性腸道疾病與類風濕性關節炎）的機制性與臨床證據，以說明持久疾病控制背後共通的免疫動力學原則。

結論：透過將治療強度與免疫系統的動態狀態對齊，CURE 可能為慢性發炎的個人化介入提供一個可轉移、以機制為導向的框架。它將疾病管理從被動的症狀驅動抑制，重新框架為主動、階段特異性的免疫穩定化，並進一步提供跨專科的共通概念語言，以支持功能性緩解、預防復發與長期組織完整性。

papers.title: Risk and outcome of interstitial lung disease in inflammatory bowel disease: evidence from a Danish nationwide population-based cohort study
papers.authors: Baekdal J, Hansen E, Meteran H, Ulrik C, Bendtsen F, Håkansson K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Extra-intestinal manifestations of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) are well-recognized, but the long-term risk of developing interstitial lung disease (ILD) in IBD and its impact on mortality remain poorly understood. We aimed to assess the risk of ILD in patients with IBD and the subsequent effect on survival.
METHODS: This nationwide cohort study (1978-2022) utilized the Danish National Patient Registry, including 53 591 patients with IBD and 267 955 age- and sex-matched controls. Adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) were estimated using Cox regression, adjusted for age, sex, education, and Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI). Cumulative incidence was assessed via the Aalen-Johansen estimator. Mortality in patients with comorbid IBD-ILD was analyzed using Cox regression and Kaplan-Meier curves.
RESULTS: The 45-year cumulative incidence of ILD was 2.1% for IBD versus 0.9% for controls (P < .001), and aHR was 2.1 (95% CI, 1.8-2.4). Furthermore, the aHR was 3.0 (95% CI, 2.2-4.1) in patients with frequent IBD-related hospitalizations compared to matched controls. The 5-year mortality in concomitant IBD and ILD was 29.3% (95% CI, 23.3-35.3) compared to 11.9% (95% CI, 9.8-14.0) for matched patients with only IBD. Male sex and higher CCI were independent risk factors for both ILD and mortality (all P < .001).
CONCLUSION: IBD is associated with a two-fold increase in ILD risk. Risk factors may include old age, longstanding disease, male sex, and comorbidity. Comorbid IBD-ILD increases mortality substantially compared to only IBD, highlighting the need for clinical awareness and early detection to improve outcomes.
papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病中間質性肺病的風險與預後：丹麥全國性人口世代研究證據
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的腸外表現已廣為人知，但IBD患者發生間質性肺病（ILD）的長期風險及其對死亡率的影響仍不清楚。本研究目的為評估IBD患者發生ILD的風險及其對存活率的後續影響。方法：本全國性世代研究（1978-2022）利用丹麥全國患者登錄系統，納入53591名IBD患者及267955名年齡性別配對對照。使用Cox回歸估計調整後風險比（aHR），並校正年齡、性別、教育程度及Charlson共病指數（CCI）。累積發生率以Aalen-Johansen估計法評估。合併IBD-ILD患者之死亡率以Cox回歸與Kaplan-Meier曲線分析。結果：ILD的45年累積發生率在IBD組為2.1%，對照組為0.9%（P < .001），aHR為2.1（95% CI, 1.8-2.4）。此外，在IBD相關住院頻繁的患者中，相較於配對對照組，aHR為3.0（95% CI, 2.2-4.1）。合併IBD與ILD患者的5年死亡率為29.3%（95% CI, 23.3-35.3），相較僅有IBD的配對患者為11.9%（95% CI, 9.8-14.0）。男性與較高CCI是ILD與死亡率的獨立危險因子（均P < .001）。結論：IBD與ILD風險增加兩倍相關。危險因子可能包括高齡、病程長、男性及共病。合併IBD-ILD相較單純IBD顯著提高死亡率，凸顯臨床警覺與早期偵測以改善預後之必要性。

papers.title: Impaired keratinization activity in perianal Crohn's fistulas is associated with poor prognosis
papers.authors: Becker M, Koelink P, Ouahoud S, Meisner S, Muncan V, Nabozny G
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Perianal fistulas remain a major complication in Crohn's disease, profoundly impacting quality of life. Although often therapy refractory, strong heterogeneity exists between patients, both in clinical behavior and therapy response. In this study, we aimed to identify biological factors involved in the clinical behavior of perianal fistulas, allowing better stratification.
METHODS: Forty-nine patients were included (Crohn's n = 36, cryptoglandular n = 13). Gene expression was analyzed in internal fistula openings and tracts by RNA sequencing. Data were verified using spatial transcriptomics and functionally in human adult organoid cultures. A gene-module score for keratinization activity was calculated and correlated to the Crohn's TOpClass classification as well as to long-term fistula outcomes.
RESULTS: Perianal fistulas were associated with the development of stratified squamous epithelium, expressing specific keratins (KRT5, KRT7, and KRT13). In human organoid models, exposing intestinal mucosa to a pro-inflammatory cytokine mixture partially induced similar changes, supporting rectal mucosal redifferentiation in response to perianal wounding. A gene-module score based on the keratinization-associated markers showed a decreasing gradient from cryptoglandular to mild Crohn-related to severe Crohn-related fistula (0.448 vs. -0.125 vs. -0.448, P = .018). Interestingly, the score was also predictive of long-term outcomes: Patients with low keratinization often showed progressive disease (14/20 patients), whereas this was not seen in the high keratinization group (0/16, P < .001).
CONCLUSION: We identify an epithelial redifferentiation process characterized by a keratinization-associated gene module as part of the healing process in perianal fistula. The extent of the keratinization not only distinguished Crohn-related from cryptoglandular fistulas but also aligned with disease severity and healing potential.
papers.title_zh: 肛周克隆氏症瘻管中角質化活性受損與不良預後相關
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：肛周瘻管仍是克隆氏症的主要併發症，嚴重影響生活品質。儘管常對治療反應不佳，但患者間在臨床表現與治療反應上存在高度異質性。本研究旨在找出參與肛周瘻管臨床表現的生物學因子，以利更好的分層。
方法：共納入49名患者（克隆氏症n=36，隱窩腺性n=13）。以RNA定序分析瘻管內開口與瘻管道的基因表現。數據以空間轉錄組學驗證，並在人類成人器官類器官培養中進行功能性驗證。計算角質化活性的基因模組分數，並與克隆氏症TOpClass分類及長期瘻管結果相關聯。
結果：肛周瘻管與分層鱗狀上皮的發育相關，表現特定角蛋白（KRT5、KRT7、KRT13）。在人類器官類器官模型中，將腸黏膜暴露於促炎細胞因子混合物部分誘導出類似變化，支持直腸黏膜在肛周傷口反應中重新分化。基於角質化相關標記的基因模組分數顯示，從隱窩腺性到輕度克隆氏症相關再到重度克隆氏症相關瘻管呈遞減梯度（0.448 vs -0.125 vs -0.448，P = .018）。有趣的是，該分數也可預測長期結果：低角質化患者常呈現進展性疾病（14/20名患者），而高角質化組則未見此現象（0/16，P < .001）。
結論：我們發現一種以角質化相關基因模組為特徵的上皮再分化過程，是肛周瘻管癒合過程的一部分。角質化的程度不僅能區分克隆氏症相關與隱窩腺性瘻管，也與疾病嚴重度及癒合潛力一致。

papers.title: Prior exposure to advanced therapy and timing of discontinuation and risk of serious infections in patients with inflammatory bowel disease initiating a new advanced therapy
papers.authors: Solitano V, Ahuja D, Qi Y, Patel S, Hupé M, Vuyyuru S
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Despite regulatory mandates for advanced therapy (AT) washout periods of up to 5 drug half-lives before enrolling patients in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) trials, the evidence base for these requirements is largely empirical, and whether shorter intervals independently increase the risk of serious infections in real-world practice remains unknown.
METHODS: Using the OptumLabs Data Warehouse, we identified adult patients with IBD who initiated a new AT (tumor necrosis factor antagonists, vedolizumab, interleukin (IL)-12/23 or IL-23 antagonists, or Janus kinase inhibitors) between 2018 and 2023 using a class-specific new-user design. We examined whether exposure to AT within the preceding 12 months (vs no exposure to AT within that window) and timing of discontinuation (≤1 month, 1-<3 months, or 3-12 months) were associated with risk of serious infections using multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression.
RESULTS: Among 21 564 AT initiators (47 ± 18 years; 52% female; 57% Crohn's disease), 7490 (34.7%) had AT exposure within the preceding 12 months. Over a mean follow-up of 1.6 ± 0.9 y, 1955 (9.1%) experienced a serious infection. Prior AT exposure was associated with higher infection risk (hazard ratio [HR]: 1.19, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.07-1.33), consistent in inverse probability of treatment-weighted analyses (HR, 1.20 [1.06-1.37]). Among patients with prior exposure, timing of discontinuation was not associated with infection risk (HR, 1.17 [0.95-1.43] for ≤1 month vs 3-12 months; HR, 1.01 [0.83-1.22] for 1-<3 months), with no dose-response relationship on continuous modeling.
DISCUSSION: AT exposure within the preceding 12 months is associated with modestly higher risk of serious infection after initiating a new AT in IBD, but timing of discontinuation does not independently influence this risk.

papers.abstract_zh:
前言：儘管監管機關要求在納入發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）試驗前，進階治療（AT）需有長達5個藥物半衰期的清洗期，但此要求的證據基礎多為經驗性，較短的間隔是否會獨立增加真實世界臨床實務中嚴重感染的風險仍屬未知。
方法：使用OptumLabs資料庫，我們以類別特異性新使用者設計，找出2018年至2023年間啟用新進階治療（腫瘤壞死因子拮抗劑、vedolizumab、IL-12/23或IL-23拮抗劑，或Janus kinase抑制劑）的成年IBD病人。我們使用多變項Cox比例風險回歸，檢視在前12個月內是否暴露於進階治療（相對於該期間內無暴露）以及停藥時間點（≤1個月、1至<3個月、或3至12個月）是否與嚴重感染風險相關。
結果：在21,564名進階治療起始病人中（年齡47±18歲；52%女性；57%克隆氏症），7,490人（34.7%）在前12個月內曾暴露於進階治療。平均追蹤1.6±0.9年，1,955人（9.1%）發生嚴重感染。先前進階治療暴露與較高感染風險相關（風險比[HR]：1.19，95%信賴區間[CI]：1.07-1.33），在逆機率治療加權分析中結果一致（HR，1.20 [1.06-1.37]）。在曾有先前暴露的病人中，停藥時間點與感染風險無關（≤1個月相對於3至12個月，HR，1.17 [0.95-1.43]；1至<3個月，HR，1.01 [0.83-1.22]），連續變項模型分析亦無劑量反應關係。

papers.title: A CDK4/6 inhibitor-armed oncolytic adenovirus reverses T cell exhaustion through the Rb-p65-CCL5 pathway and potentiates the antitumor activity of anti-PD-1 or CAR-T therapy in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Zhou D, Ran B, Kong L, Liu Y, Xiao L, Chen X
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: The efficacy of oncolytic adenoviruses in colorectal cancer models is constrained by a treatment-induced limitation: the high-dose, repetitive administration required for sustained oncolysis promotes chronic antigen exposure and tumor microenvironmental stress, driving CD8+ T cells into a state of exhaustion.
METHODS: To mitigate this, we constructed an oncolytic adenovirus, ADV-PTD4-D3, engineered for intratumoral expression of a peptide inhibitor of CDK4/6. This local strategy aims to retain immunomodulatory potential while minimizing systemic exposure. In syngeneic murine models, ADV-PTD4-D3 demonstrated improved tumor control and the ability to induce robust, antigen-specific immunological memory, with its therapeutic effect being primarily dependent on CD8+ T cells. Notably, it also exhibited potent antitumor activity in a humanized xenograft model and showed no evidence of significant off-target toxicity in immunocompetent hosts.
RESULTS: The mechanism involves a signaling axis where viral-mediated CDK4/6 inhibition reduces retinoblastoma (Rb) protein phosphorylation. This decrease relieves Rb-mediated sequestration of the NF-kB p65 subunit, allowing p65 nuclear translocation and transcriptional upregulation of the T-cell chemoattractant CCL5, a factor linked to favorable patient prognosis. Thus, ADV-PTD4-D3 promotes a T-cell-inflamed microenvironment by providing a sustained chemotactic signal CCL5 for CD8+ T cell recruitment. Furthermore, this treatment strategy successfully reverses the functional exhaustion of infiltrating CD8+ T cells, thereby addressing two major barriers to effective therapy: inadequate infiltration and functional exhaustion. By modifying the tumor microenvironment in this way, the armed virus addresses two factors that limit T-cell-based immunotherapies: inadequate infiltration and functional exhaustion. Correspondingly, ADV-PTD4-D3 treatment improved the antitumor response to both PD-1 blockade and CAR-T cell therapy in combination studies.
DISCUSSION: These findings suggest that engineering oncolytic viruses to locally modulate pathways involved in T cell exhaustion represents a viable and translatable strategy for enhancing antitumor immunity.

papers.abstract_zh: 前言：溶瘤腺病毒在大腸直腸癌模型中的療效受限於治療本身導致的問題——維持溶瘤作用所需的高劇量、重複給藥會促成慢性抗原暴露與腫瘤微環境壓力，導致CD8+ T細胞進入耗竭狀態。方法：為緩解此問題，我們建構了一種溶瘤腺病毒ADV-PTD4-D3，經工程改造使其在腫瘤內表達CDK4/6胜肽抑制劑。此局部策略旨在保留免疫調節潛力，同時降低全身性暴露。在同基因小鼠模型中，ADV-PTD4-D3展現出更佳的腫瘤控制效果，並能誘導強健的抗原特異性免疫記憶，其治療效果主要依賴CD8+ T細胞。值得注意的是，該病毒在人源化異種移植模型中也展現強效抗腫瘤活性，且在免疫功能正常宿主中未觀察到明顯的脫靶毒性。結果：其機轉涉及一條訊號軸：病毒媒介的CDK4/6抑制降低視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白（Rb）的磷酸化，此降低作用解除了Rb對NF-κB p65次單元的隔離作用，使p65得以進入細胞核並轉錄上調T細胞化學誘引因子CCL5（此因子與較佳病人預後相關）。因此，ADV-PTD4-D3透過提供持續性的CCL5化學誘引訊號來促進CD8+ T細胞浸潤，形成T細胞發炎性微環境。此外，此治療策略成功逆轉浸潤性CD8+ T細胞的功能性耗竭，同時解決了浸潤不足與功能耗竭這兩大免疫療效障礙。透過如此改變腫瘤微環境，此武裝病毒解決了限制T細胞為基礎免疫療法的兩項因素：浸潤不足與功能耗竭。相應地，ADV-PTD4-D3治療在聯合治療研究中提升了對PD-1阻斷劑與CAR-T細胞療法的抗腫瘤反應。討論：這些發現顯示，將溶瘤病毒工程改造以局部調控T細胞耗竭相關路徑，是增強抗腫瘤免疫力的一種可行且具轉譯潛力的策略。

papers.title: Surgical Treatment and Postoperative Surveillance for Familial Adenomatous Polyposis
papers.authors: Shibutani M, Seki Y, Kasashima H, Maeda K
papers.abstract: Familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) is a genetic disease caused by APC mutation. It develops into multiple adenomatous polyps when patients are in their early 20s and eventually transforms into colorectal cancer at 100% penetrance unless treated. Therefore, prophylactic surgery is the only effective treatment option. However, individual approaches such as total colectomy with ileorectal anastomosis, proctocolectomy with stapled ileal pouch-anal anastomosis (IPAA), proctocolectomy with mucosectomy, hand-sewn IPAA, and total proctocolectomy with end ileostomy are required based on the balance between the risk of metachronous rectal cancer, postoperative complications, and decreased anal function. Herein, we summarize the current evidence regarding the surgical treatment and postoperative surveillance for FAP.

papers.title: Metagenomic analysis of human feces reveals gut microbiome role in colorectal cancer
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.authors: Gu Z, Tan Q, Mao D, Zhang Y, Wang Y, He D
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: This study aimed to identify the microbiota and specific genes that are closely associated with colorectal cancer (CRC) through metagenomic sequencing and integrative multi-omics analysis.
METHODS: Fecal samples were collected from 11 healthy volunteers and 20 patients with CRC. Genomic DNA was extracted for metagenomic analysis and high-throughput sequencing. Compositional differences and correlations of the gut microbiome were compared based on species and functional diversity.
RESULTS: The overall species composition included 1,980 species, with 1,707 species identified in the CRC group and 1,525 in the healthy control group. Alpha diversity was significantly lower in the CRC group than in the healthy control group (p = 0.014). Beta diversity analysis revealed significant differences between the two groups (stress = 0.1308, p = 0.021). Based on LEfSe analysis, Shigella, Porphyromonas, Proteus, Bacteroides, Alistipes, Fusobacterium, and Escherichia were more abundant in patients with CRC, whereas Eubacterium, Clostridium, Dialister, Faecalibacterium, Blautia, Coprococcus, Dorea, Subdoligranulum, Megamonas, Roseburia, and Prevotella were significantly more abundant in the healthy control group (p < 0.05).
CONCLUSION: A multidimensional microbial diagnostic model, incorporating Shigella, Porphyromonas, Proteus, Bacteroides, Fusobacterium, Escherichia, Eubacterium, Clostridium, Dialister, Faecalibacterium, Blautia, Coprococcus, Dorea, Subdoligranulum, Megamonas, Roseburia, and Prevotella, suggests the potential to enhance early CRC screening performance. Furthermore, LptA, tnaA, envC, and argB may represent promising candidates for novel therapeutic targets, warranting further investigation.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在透過巨基因體序列分析與整合多體學分析，找出與大腸直腸癌（CRC）密切相關的微生物群與特定基因。方法：收集11名健康志願者與20名CRC患者的糞便樣本，抽取基因體DNA進行巨基因體分析與高通量序列分析，並基於物種與功能多樣性比較腸道微生物群的組成差異與相關性。結果：整體物種組成共包含1,980種，CRC組中鑑定出1,707種，健康對照組中鑑定出1,525種。CRC組的alpha多樣性顯著低於健康對照組（p = 0.014）。beta多樣性分析顯示兩組間有顯著差異（stress = 0.1308，p = 0.021）。根據LEfSe分析，Shigella、Porphyromonas、Proteus、Bacteroides、Alistipes、Fusobacterium與Escherichia在CRC患者中較豐富，而Eubacterium、Clostridium、Dialister、Faecalibacterium、Blautia、Coprococcus、Dorea、Subdoligranulum、Megamonas、Roseburia與Prevotella在健康對照組中顯著較豐富（p < 0.05）。結論：一個納入Shigella、Porphyromonas、Proteus、Bacteroides、Fusobacterium、Escherichia、Eubacterium、Clostridium、Dialister、Faecalibacterium、Blautia、Coprococcus、Dorea、Subdoligranulum、Megamonas、Roseburia與Prevotella的多維微生物診斷模型，顯示有提升早期CRC篩檢效能的潛力。此外，LptA、tnaA、envC與argB可能是具潛力的新型治療靶點候選基因，值得進一步研究。

papers.title: Phytofabrication of Chitosan-MgO nanocomposites: Evaluation of their antioxidant, antibacterial, anticancer, and zebrafish embryo biocompatibility properties
papers.journal_full: Journal of photochemistry and photobiology. B, Biology
papers.authors: Begum M, Rajkumar M, Govindaraj P, Meenambigai K, Alhamod M, Alotaibi H
papers.abstract: Phytofabrication of polymer-based nanocomposites has emerged as a promising approach for developing multifunctional biomaterials with enhanced therapeutic efficacy. In the present study, chitosan-coated magnesium oxide nanocomposites (CS-MgONCs) were successfully synthesized via a green biogenic route using Abutilon indicum leaf extract, integrating the advantages of biopolymers and metal oxides. The formation of CS-MgONCs was preliminarily confirmed by UV-Vis spectroscopy with a characteristic absorption peak at 280 nm. FTIR analysis revealed the involvement of key functional groups responsible for reduction and stabilization, while XRD patterns confirmed the crystalline nature of the nanocomposites. HR-TEM demonstrated a predominantly semi-spherical morphology with an average particle size of 58.93 nm. DLS and zeta potential analyses indicated good colloidal stability, with a surface charge of +8.76 mV, attributed to the chitosan coating. Functionally, CS-MgONCs exhibited significant dose-dependent antioxidant activity, achieving a maximum DPPH radical scavenging efficiency of 78.37 ± 1.34% at 200 μg/mL. The nanocomposites also demonstrated potent antibacterial activity against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens, with notable zones of inhibition against Staphylococcus aureus (20.71 ± 0.74 mm) and Escherichia coli (19.71 ± 0.74 mm). Furthermore, marked anti-inflammatory activity was observed through inhibition of cyclooxygenase (COX), with 77.58 ± 1.37% suppression of COX-2 activity, suggesting effective modulation of inflammatory pathways. Biocompatibility assessment in zebrafish embryo models indicated acceptable safety profiles, with a 70% survival rate at 200 μg/mL. Importantly, the nanocomposites exhibited pronounced anticancer activity against HT-29 colon cancer cells, reducing cell viability to 21.48 ± 0.98% in a concentration-dependent manner. In conclusion, the findings highlight that biogenically synthesized CS-MgONCs integrate structural stability with multifunctional biological performance, positioning them as promising candidates for future biomedical and therapeutic applications.

papers.abstract_zh: 以聚合物為基礎之奈米複合材料的植物合成法，已成為開發具增強治療效力之多功能生物材料的有前景方法。本研究以Abutilon indicum（磨盤草）葉片萃取物，透過綠色生物合成途徑成功合成幾丁聚醣包覆氧化鎂奈米複合材料（CS-MgONCs），結合生物聚合物與金屬氧化物之優點。UV-Vis光譜於280 nm處出現特徵吸收峰，初步確認CS-MgONCs之形成。FTIR分析顯示參與還原與穩定作用之關鍵官能基，XRD圖譜確認奈米複合材料之結晶特性。HR-TEM顯示其形態主要為半球形，平均粒徑為58.93 nm。DLS與zeta電位分析顯示良好之膠體穩定性，表面電荷為+8.76 mV，歸因於幾丁聚醣包覆。功能性方面，CS-MgONCs展現顯著劑量依賴性抗氧化活性，於200 μg/mL時DPPH自由基清除效率最高達78.37 ± 1.34%。此奈米複合材料亦對革蘭氏陽性與陰性病原菌展現強效抗菌活性，對金黃色葡萄球菌（20.71 ± 0.74 mm）及大腸桿菌（19.71 ± 0.74 mm）之抑菌圈明顯。此外，透過抑制環氧化酶（COX）觀察到顯著抗發炎活性，COX-2活性抑制率達77.58 ± 1.37%，顯示其有效調節發炎路徑。斑馬魚胚胎模型之生物相容性評估顯示安全性尚可接受，於200 μg/mL時存活率為70%。重要的是，此奈米複合材料對HT-29大腸癌細胞展現顯著抗癌活性，以濃度依賴方式使細胞存活率降至21.48 ± 0.98%。總結而言，本研究結果顯示生物合成之CS-MgONCs整合結構穩定性與多功能生物性能，為未來生醫與治療應用之潛力候選材料。

papers.title: Tissue Context Shapes Distinct Premalignant Outcomes in an HPV16 E6/E7-Mutant Pik3ca Transgenic Mouse Model
papers.ptype: Research Support, N.I.H., Extramural, Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
papers.authors: Ayre M, Fernandez-Ugazio G, DiGaudio A, Coso O, Gutkind J, Raimondi A
papers.abstract:
UNLABELLED: High-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) infection, particularly HPV16, is a major etiologic factor associated with multiple human cancers, including anal, cervical, and oropharyngeal carcinomas. However, the mechanisms underlying tissue-specific responses to HPV oncogene expression remain poorly understood. In this study, we developed and characterized a double-inducible transgenic mouse model enabling spatially and temporally controlled expression of HPV16 E6/E7 oncoproteins in K14-positive epithelial progenitor cells of both the anal and oral mucosae. Within 2 months of induction, HPV16 E6/E7 expression elicited epithelial hyperplasia and dysplasia in both tissues but with distinct outcomes: low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions in the anal canal and moderate to severe dysplasia in the tongue. Continuous oncogene expression was required for lesion maintenance, as doxycycline withdrawal reversed the proliferative phenotype, indicating a dynamic and reversible process. To assess whether activation of the PI3K pathway could cooperate with HPV oncogenes, we combined the E6/E7 model with a Pik3caH1047R knock-in mouse line. Constitutive PI3K activation alone induced mild dysplasia in both epithelia, whereas its combination with E6/E7 enhanced dysplastic severity in the tongue but not in the anal mucosa. No progression to invasive carcinoma was observed within 6 months. These findings demonstrate that identical oncogenic signals-HPV16 E6/E7 expression and PI3K activation-produce distinct premalignant outcomes depending on epithelial context. This work highlights the critical role of local microenvironmental factors in HPV-driven carcinogenesis and provides a platform to identify tissue-specific therapeutic vulnerabilities in HPV-associated cancers.
SIGNIFICANCE: This work presents a double-inducible mouse model showing that HPV16 E6/E7 and PI3K activation drives distinct dysplastic outcomes in anal and oral epithelia. The study highlights how tissue context and microenvironment critically shape HPV oncogene effects, offering an important tool for uncovering mechanisms and therapeutic targets in HPV-related cancers.

未標示：高危險型人類乳突病毒（HPV）感染，尤其是HPV16，是包括肛門癌、子宮頸癌及口咽癌等多種人類癌症的主要致病因子。然而，組織特異性反應於HPV致癌基因表現背後的機制仍所知有限。本研究中，我們建立並鑑定了一個雙重可誘導轉基因小鼠模型，能在肛門及口腔黏膜的K14陽性上皮前驅細胞中，於空間與時間上受控地表現HPV16 E6/E7致癌蛋白。誘導後2個月內，HPV16 E6/E7表現在兩種組織皆引發上皮增生與異型增生，但結果不同：肛管出現低度鱗狀上皮內病變，舌部則出現中至重度異型增生。持續的致癌基因表現為維持病變所必需，因為停用doxycycline後可逆轉增生表型，顯示此為動態且可逆的過程。為評估PI3K路徑活化是否能與HPV致癌基因協同作用，我們將E6/E7模型與Pik3caH1047R基因剔入小鼠品系結合。單獨的PI3K持續活化在兩種上皮皆誘發輕度異型增生，而其與E6/E7結合則加重舌部異型增生嚴重度，但對肛門黏膜無此效果。6個月內未觀察到進展為侵襲性癌。這些發現顯示，相同的致癌訊號——HPV16 E6/E7表現與PI3K活化——會依上皮組織背景不同而產生不同的癌前病變結果。本研究強調局部微環境因子在HPV驅動致癌過程中的關鍵角色，並提供一個平台以鑑定HPV相關癌症中組織特異性的治療脆弱點。

重要性：本研究提出一個雙重可誘導小鼠模型，顯示HPV16 E6/E7與PI3K活化在肛門與口腔上皮中驅動不同的異型增生結果。本研究凸顯組織背景與微環境如何關鍵性地塑造HPV致癌基因效應，為揭示HPV相關癌症的機制與治療靶點提供重要工具。

papers.title: Stage-Specific carcinogenic mechanisms and intervention strategies for pks+ Escherichia coli-associated colorectal cancer
papers.authors: He Y, Li T, Sun H, Yang J
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) incidence is increasing in many regions, particularly among individuals younger than 50 years. The gut microbiota has emerged as an important regulator of CRC development and treatment response. Among microbial factors, Escherichia coli (E. coli) strains harboring the polyketide synthase (pks) gene island are of particular interest because they produce the genotoxin colibactin. Colibactin induces DNA damage and characteristic mutational signatures, suggesting a potential role in CRC evolution. Rather than acting as a single carcinogenic factor, pks⁺ E. coli-associated carcinogenesis can be viewed as a host-microbe interaction-driven, multistage process involving bacterial colonization, colibactin biosynthesis, DNA damage, mutation accumulation, cellular fate remodeling, microenvironmental amplification, host susceptibility, and clonal expansion. This review summarizes stage-specific intervention strategies, including control of carcinogenic bacteria, blockade of virulence factors, modulation of host responses, microenvironment remodeling, and integration with conventional therapies, providing a framework for precision CRC prevention and treatment.

papers.title: Redefining textbook outcome in contemporary colon surgery
papers.journal_full: Journal of gastrointestinal surgery : official journal of the Society for Surgery of the Alimentary Tract
papers.authors: Zeller M, Ma R, Wetherell J, Felton J, Nasseri Y, Wolf J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Textbook outcome (TO) is a composite measure of surgical quality, but existing definitions in colon surgery predate the widespread adoption of minimally invasive surgery and contemporary, perioperative recovery pathways. We sought to redefine TO using a contemporary and data-driven length-of-stay (LOS) standard and evaluate its incidence, temporal trends, and predictors after elective colectomy.
METHODS: We performed a retrospective cohort study using the American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement Program database from 2012 to 2022. Adult patients undergoing elective colectomy were included. TO was defined as LOS ≤ 3 days and the absence of 30-day morbidity, mortality, readmission, or reoperation. The LOS threshold was informed by cohort-level LOS distribution analysis, demonstrating a modal LOS of 3 days. Trends in TO achievement and factors associated with TO were analyzed using multivariable logistic regression.
RESULTS: Among the 139,064 patients included, 44.5% achieved TO. TO rates improved significantly from 29.3% in 2012 to 50.2% in 2022 (P <.001), with rates plateauing after 2019. Minimally invasive approaches were strongly associated with TO, particularly robotic (odds ratio [OR], 8.30; 95% CI, 7.90-8.73) and laparoscopic (OR, 4.21; 95% CI, 4.03-4.39) surgery. Reduced odds of TO were associated with age > 80 years (OR, 0.46; 95% CI, 0.43-0.48), frailty index ≥ 3 (OR, 0.48; 95% CI, 0.42-0.55), nonhome discharge (OR, 0.21; 95% CI, 0.19-0.23), indication of bleeding (OR, 0.53; 95% CI, 0.38-0.72), and ostomy creation (OR, 0.52; 95% CI, 0.49-0.55), all P <.001.
CONCLUSION: A contemporary TO definition incorporating LOS ≤ 3 days identifies a rigorous and clinically relevant recovery benchmark after elective colectomy. TO achievement improved substantially over the study period. Minimally invasive approaches, particularly robotic surgery, were strongly associated with TO achievement, whereas advanced age, frailty, and nonhome discharge were associated with a lower likelihood of TO. Our contemporary TO definition may provide a patient-centered framework for evaluating perioperative recovery quality and contextualizing outcomes in modern colon surgery.

背景：教科書式結果（TO）是手術品質的複合指標，但大腸手術現有定義是在微創手術與當代術後恢復路徑（如ERAS）廣泛採用之前訂定的。我們試圖以當代、資料驅動的住院天數（LOS）標準重新定義TO，並評估其在選擇性大腸切除術後的發生率、時間趨勢與預測因子。
方法：我們使用美國外科醫學會全國外科品質改善計畫（ACS NSQIP）資料庫2012至2022年資料進行回溯性世代研究。納入接受選擇性大腸切除之成年病人。TO定義為LOS≤3天且無30天內併發症、死亡、再入院或再手術。LOS門檻依世代層級之LOS分布分析訂定，顯示最常見（modal）LOS為3天。以多變項邏輯回歸分析TO達成之趨勢與相關因子。
結果：在納入之139,064名病人中，44.5%達成TO。TO達成率顯著自2012年29.3%上升至2022年50.2%（P<.001），2019年後趨於平緩。微創手術方式與TO達成顯著相關，尤其機器人手術（勝算比[OR] 8.30；95%信賴區間[CI] 7.90-8.73）及腹腔鏡手術（OR 4.21；95% CI 4.03-4.39）。TO達成勝算降低的相關因子包括年齡>80歲（OR 0.46；95% CI 0.43-0.48）、衰弱指數≥3（OR 0.48；95% CI 0.42-0.55）、非居家出院（OR 0.21；95% CI 0.19-0.23）、出血適應症（OR 0.53；95% CI 0.38-0.72）、及造口製作（OR 0.52；95% CI 0.49-0.55），皆P<.001。
結論：納入LOS≤3天之當代TO定義，提供選擇性大腸切除術後嚴謹且具臨床意義的恢復基準。研究期間TO達成率大幅提升。微創手術方式，尤其機器人手術，與TO達成強烈相關，而高齡、衰弱與非居家出院則與較低TO達成率相關。此當代TO定義可能為評估當代大腸手術之圍術期恢復品質與結果情境化提供以病人為中心的框架。

papers.title: FUT2-Mediated Fucosylation of OLFM4 Promotes Colon Cancer Cell Differentiation
papers.authors: Duan C, Zhang K, Hou L, Chen J, Liu J, Shi H
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Fucosyltransferase 2 (FUT2) deficiency exacerbates inflammation, a known risk factor for colon cancer. However, the precise role and underlying mechanism of FUT2 in regulating colon cancer cell differentiation remain unclear. Although olfactomedin-4 (OLFM4) has been known to have a tumor-suppressive effect, its functional interaction with FUT2 in colon cancer remains unexplored.
METHODS: FUT2 expression levels were assessed using TCGA and cBioPortal databases and in different colon cancer cell lines. ALP assays were performed to evaluate the effect of FUT2 on cancer cell differentiation. Transwell invasion assays, scratch assays, and tumor sphere formation assays were used to investigate the functional effects of FUT2 on colon cancer cells. N-glycosylation proteomics and UEA-I chromatography were used to identify the regulatory effect of FUT2 on OLFM4 fucosylation.
RESULTS: FUT2 expression was associated with the differentiation degree of colon cancer cell lines. Based on their endogenous FUT2 expression, we overexpressed FUT2 in SW480 cells (low baseline) and knocked it down in HT29 cells (high baseline). Overexpressing FUT2 promoted the differentiation of SW480 cells and inhibited their migration, invasion, EMT, and stemness. Conversely, knockdown of FUT2 in HT29 cells reduced its degree of differentiation and increased its malignancy. N-glycosylation proteomics analysis and UEA-I chromatography indicated OLFM4 as a downstream target of FUT2. FUT2-mediated fucosylation of OLFM4 is positively correlated with the degree of cancer cell differentiation. Knockdown of OLFM4 attenuated differentiation in FUT2-overexpressing SW480 cells, while overexpression of OLFM4 produced opposite effects.
CONCLUSION: FUT2 promotes colon cancer cell differentiation by mediating OLFM4 fucosylation, suggesting that FUT2 may serve as a therapeutic target for colon cancer.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：岩藻糖基轉移酶2（FUT2）缺乏會加重發炎反應，而發炎已知是大腸癌的危險因子。然而FUT2調控大腸癌細胞分化的確切角色與機轉尚不清楚。嗅覺標記蛋白4（OLFM4）已知具有腫瘤抑制作用，但其與FUT2在大腸癌中的功能性交互作用仍未被探討。
方法：利用TCGA與cBioPortal資料庫及不同大腸癌細胞株評估FUT2表現量。以ALP檢測評估FUT2對癌細胞分化的影響。以Transwell侵襲試驗、劃痕試驗與腫瘤球形成試驗探討FUT2對大腸癌細胞的功能性影響。利用N-醣基化蛋白質體學與UEA-I親和層析法鑑定FUT2對OLFM4岩藻糖基化的調控作用。
結果：FUT2表現量與大腸癌細胞株的分化程度相關。根據內生性FUT2表現量，我們在SW480細胞（低基礎表現）中過度表現FUT2，並在HT29細胞（高基礎表現）中將其剔除。過度表現FUT2促進SW480細胞分化，並抑制其遷移、侵襲、上皮間質轉化（EMT）及幹性。相反地，在HT29細胞中剔除FUT2則降低其分化程度並增加其惡性度。N-醣基化蛋白質體學分析與UEA-I層析顯示OLFM4為FUT2的下游目標。FUT2媒介之OLFM4岩藻糖基化與癌細胞分化程度呈正相關。在FUT2過度表現的SW480細胞中剔除OLFM4會減弱分化作用，而過度表現OLFM4則產生相反效果。
結論：FUT2透過媒介OLFM4岩藻糖基化促進大腸癌細胞分化，提示FUT2可能作為大腸癌的治療靶點。

papers.title: The rs10781468 Genetic Polymorphism of the Gαq (GNAQ) Gene Is Associated With Responsiveness to Opioid Analgesics in Patients With Postoperative and Cancer Pain: An Exploratory Study
papers.authors: Owada H, Nishizawa D, Mieda T, Tsujita M, Nakagawa H, Yamaguchi S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: G protein-coupled receptors, the largest class of cell surface receptors, are ubiquitously expressed throughout the body. Different subtypes of G protein α subunits activate distinct intracellular signaling pathways and mediate opioid analgesic effects. However, the contributions of these Gα subunits remain unclear. We conducted a hypothesis-generating, two-stage candidate gene association study to identify potential genetic loci related to pain processing and opioid analgesia, focusing on genes encoding G protein α subunits.
METHODS: To identify candidate single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in seven genes encoding G protein α subunits, we analyzed postoperative opioid consumption, pain intensity, and opioid responsiveness in two exploratory cohorts [laparoscopy-assisted colectomy (n = 350) and mandibular plastic surgery (n = 354)]. For identified candidate SNPs, we further evaluated opioid responsiveness in a confirmatory cohort of 89 patients with cancer pain. We also conducted a preliminary sensitivity analysis adjusting for relevant covariates.
RESULTS: Two SNPs (rs10781468 in the GNAQ gene and rs308049 in the GNA11 gene) showed significant associations in both exploratory cohorts. Patients with postoperative pain who were homozygous for the minor allele of rs10781468 exhibited higher opioid sensitivity or lower pain severity. In the confirmatory cohort, homozygosity for the major allele of rs10781468 was significantly associated with increased opioid sensitivity for cancer pain management under the dominant model (p = 0.025) and the genotypic model (p = 0.020), whereas rs308049 was not. The observed phenotypes and associated genetic models differed across cohorts, and sensitivity analyses continued to demonstrate some significant associations.
CONCLUSIONS: As a hypothesis-generating investigation, we suggest that rs10781468 may serve as a potential candidate marker of responsiveness to opioid analgesics. Our findings should be validated in a large-scale study with a homogeneous pain type in which the opioid administration protocol is controlled to further examine the association observed in this exploratory study.

papers.title_zh: Gαq (GNAQ) 基因 rs10781468 基因多型性與術後及癌症疼痛患者類鴉片止痛劑反應性之相關性：一項探索性研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：G蛋白偶聯受體是細胞表面受體中最大的一類，廣泛表達於全身各處。不同亞型的G蛋白α次單元活化不同的細胞內訊號路徑，並調節類鴉片止痛效果。然而這些Gα次單元的貢獻仍不清楚。我們進行了一項假設生成性的兩階段候選基因關聯研究，聚焦於編碼G蛋白α次單元的基因，以找出與疼痛處理及類鴉片止痛相關的潛在基因位點。

方法：為找出七個編碼G蛋白α次單元基因中的候選單核苷酸多型性(SNP)，我們在兩個探索性佇列[腹腔鏡輔助結腸切除術(n=350)及下顎整形手術(n=354)]中分析術後類鴉片消耗量、疼痛強度及類鴉片反應性。針對找出的候選SNP，我們進一步在一個由89名癌症疼痛患者組成的確認佇列中評估類鴉片反應性。我們也進行了初步的敏感性分析，調整相關共變項。

結果：兩個SNP（GNAQ基因的rs10781468與GNA11基因的rs308049）在兩個探索性佇列中均顯示顯著關聯。術後疼痛患者中，rs10781468次要等位基因同型合子者表現出較高的類鴉片敏感性或較低的疼痛嚴重度。在確認佇列中，rs10781468主要等位基因同型合子在顯性模式（p=0.025）及基因型模式（p=0.020）下與癌症疼痛管理中類鴉片敏感性增加顯著相關，而rs308049則無此關聯。觀察到的表現型與相關基因模式在不同佇列間有所差異，敏感性分析仍顯示部分顯著關聯。

結論：作為一項假設生成性研究，我們認為rs10781468可能是類鴉片止痛劑反應性的潛在候選標記。我們的發現應在一項針對同質性疼痛類型、且類鴉片給藥方案受控制的大規模研究中進一步驗證。

papers.title: Anti-tumor Effects of Loureirin A Treatment in Colorectal Cancer Cells via Inhibition of AKT Phosphorylation
papers.authors: Ma R, Shimura T, Huang Y, Yoshimura K, Kitajima T, Yamashita S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND/AIM: Loureirin A, a bioactive monomer derived from Sanguis Draconis flavones, is a traditional Chinese medicine extract recognized for its potent antioxidant properties. Although pharmacological therapies for colorectal cancer (CRC) continue to advance, the overall prognosis of CRC patients remains dismal. Therefore, alternative treatment strategies, such as complementary and alternative medicine, should be considered to aid in the management of this malignancy. In this study, we aimed to investigate the anti-cancer effects and mechanisms of Loureirin A treatment in CRC.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We performed various in vitro experiments, including cell proliferation, colony formation, and apoptosis assays, following treatment of two CRC cell lines (HCT116 and HT29) with increasing concentrations of Loureirin A.
RESULTS: Loureirin A exerts anti-cancer effects in CRC by significantly inhibiting cell proliferation, reducing colony formation, and enhancing apoptotic activity compared with the control group. These effects occurred in a dose-dependent manner. Moreover, Loureirin A treatment could significantly reduce the levels of phosphorylated protein kinase B (AKT) in both CRC cell lines by western blot analysis.
CONCLUSION: Loureirin A exhibits anti-cancer effects in CRC cells and may serve as a potential adjunctive treatment option for this disease.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景/目的：Loureirin A 是一種從血竭黃酮類中提取的生物活性單體，是傳統中藥萃取物，以其強效抗氧化特性著稱。儘管大腸直腸癌（CRC）的藥物治療持續進展，CRC 病人的整體預後仍不佳。因此，應考慮替代治療策略，如輔助與替代醫學，以協助管理此惡性腫瘤。本研究旨在探討 Loureirin A 治療 CRC 的抗癌作用與機轉。

材料與方法：我們對兩種 CRC 細胞株（HCT116 與 HT29）以遞增濃度的 Loureirin A 處理後，進行多種體外實驗，包括細胞增殖、克隆形成及凋亡分析。

結果：相較於對照組，Loureirin A 透過顯著抑制細胞增殖、減少克隆形成及增強凋亡活性，對 CRC 產生抗癌作用。這些效應呈劑量依賴性。此外，經西方墨點法分析，Loureirin A 治療可顯著降低兩種 CRC 細胞株中磷酸化蛋白激酶 B（AKT）的水平。

結論：Loureirin A 對 CRC 細胞展現抗癌作用，可能作為此疾病的潛在輔助治療選項。

papers.title: Geographic Disparities in Socioeconomic Factors and Advanced-stage Presentation in Rectosigmoid Cancer: A National Cancer Database Analysis
papers.authors: Demirors B, Godbole N, Brock L, Bowers J, Manaise H, Mahesh V
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND/AIM: Rectosigmoid cancer is a clinically distinct subset of colorectal malignancy, yet geographic variation in its demographic and socioeconomic profile across U.S. regions remains poorly characterized. Understanding regional disparities in patient composition and stage at diagnosis is essential for guiding targeted public health strategies. This study examined geographic variation in demographic, socioeconomic, and clinical characteristics among U.S. patients with rectosigmoid cancer.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: Using the National Cancer Database (NCDB), we conducted a cross-sectional analysis of patients diagnosed with rectosigmoid cancer between 2004 and 2020. Patients were assigned to one of six U.S. geographic regions based on reporting facility location. Descriptive analyses were performed to evaluate age, sex, race and ethnicity, insurance type, income, urban-rural residence, and American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) stage at diagnosis.
RESULTS: Among 1,044,912 patients (mean age, 65.0 years; 55.9% male), substantial racial and socioeconomic variation was identified across regions. Black patients were most prevalent in the Southeast (15.6%) and least represented in the Mountain region (1.8%). Asian patients were highest in the Pacific region (16.2%). Uninsured rates were highest in the Southwest (6.9%) and Southeast (4.5%). Advanced-stage (III-IV) disease at diagnosis was most common in the Southwest (52.9%) and least common in the Northeast (47.4%).
CONCLUSION: Substantial geographic variation exists in the demographic and socioeconomic profile of patients with rectosigmoid cancer, corresponding to meaningful differences in stage at diagnosis. These disparities likely reflect structural inequities in screening access, insurance coverage, and healthcare infrastructure. Region-specific interventions, including Medicaid expansion, mobile screening programs, and targeted patient navigation, are warranted to improve outcomes nationwide.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景/目的：直腸乙狀結腸癌是大腸直腸惡性腫瘤中臨床上獨特的一個子群，然而其人口學及社經特徵在美國各地區間的地理差異仍未被充分描述。了解患者組成與診斷期別的區域性差異，對於指導針對性的公共衛生策略至關重要。本研究檢視美國直腸乙狀結腸癌患者在人口學、社經及臨床特徵上的地理變異。方法：利用全國癌症資料庫（NCDB），我們對2004年至2020年間診斷為直腸乙狀結腸癌的患者進行橫斷面分析。依據報告機構所在地，將患者分配至美國六大地理區域之一。以描述性分析評估年齡、性別、種族與族群、保險類型、收入、城鄉居住地，以及美國癌症聯合委員會（AJCC）診斷期別。結果：在1,044,912名患者中（平均年齡65.0歲，男性55.9%），各區域間發現顯著的種族與社經差異。黑人患者比例在東南部最高（15.6%），在山區地帶最低（1.8%）。亞裔患者在太平洋地區最高（16.2%）。未保險率在西南部最高（6.9%），東南部次之（4.5%）。晚期（III-IV期）疾病於診斷時最常見於西南部（52.9%），最少見於東北部（47.4%）。結論：直腸乙狀結腸癌患者的人口學與社經特徵存在顯著地理差異，且與診斷期別的重要差異相對應。這些差異可能反映篩檢可及性、保險覆蓋及醫療基礎設施上的結構性不平等。建議採取區域性介入措施，包括Medicaid擴大、行動篩檢計畫及針對性患者導航，以改善全國性結果。

papers.title: Association Between Body Mass Index and Overall Survival in Patients With Colorectal Cancer in Taiwan
papers.authors: Kuo T, Wang W, Hsiao W, Yen Y, Yeh C
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND/AIM: Colorectal cancer (CRC) represents an increasing global health burden. Evidence suggests that body mass index (BMI) may influence survival in CRC; however, large-scale data from Asian populations and sex-specific differences remain limited. We investigated the association between BMI and overall survival among patients with CRC in Taiwan.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: We conducted a nationwide cohort study using the Taiwan Cancer Registry linked with National Health Insurance claims for patients with CRC diagnosed between 2011 and 2020. A total of 96,500 patients were categorized as underweight (<18.50 kg/m2), normal weight (18.50-23.99 kg/m2), overweight (24.00-26.99 kg/m2), or obese (≥27.00 kg/m2).
RESULTS: During follow-up to December 2021, 37,728 deaths occurred. Compared with normal BMI, underweight status was associated with higher mortality [adjusted hazard ratio (aHR)=1.61, 95% confidence interval (CI)=1.55-1.67], whereas overweight (aHR=0.80, 95%CI=0.78-0.82) and obesity (aHR=0.77, 95%CI=0.75-0.80) were associated with reduced mortality risk. Sex-stratified analyses demonstrated consistent trends across both sexes: underweight status significantly increased mortality in men (aHR=1.70, 95%CI=1.63-1.79) and women (aHR=1.52, 95%CI=1.45-1.60), whereas overweight and obesity remained protective factors for both sexes (all p<0.05).
CONCLUSION: These findings exhibit a significant association between BMI and mortality in patients with CRC. Underweight status confers increased mortality, while overweight or obesity is associated with improved survival in both men and women.

papers.title_zh: 台灣大腸直腸癌（CRC）患者身體質量指數（BMI）與整體存活之關聯性研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景/目的：大腸直腸癌（CRC）是全球日益嚴重的健康負擔。有證據顯示身體質量指數（BMI）可能影響CRC存活，然而亞洲人群的大規模資料及性別特異性差異仍有限。我們探討台灣CRC患者中BMI與整體存活之關聯。

患者與方法：我們利用台灣癌症登記資料庫連結全民健保申報資料，進行全國性世代研究，納入2011年至2020年間診斷之CRC患者。共96,500名患者依BMI分為體重過輕（<18.50 kg/m2）、正常體重（18.50-23.99 kg/m2）、過重（24.00-26.99 kg/m2）或肥胖（≥27.00 kg/m2）四組。

結果：追蹤至2021年12月，共發生37,728例死亡。與正常BMI相比，體重過輕與較高死亡率相關［校正後風險比（aHR）=1.61，95%信賴區間（CI）=1.55-1.67］，而過重（aHR=0.80，95% CI=0.78-0.82）與肥胖（aHR=0.77，95% CI=0.75-0.80）則與較低死亡風險相關。性別分層分析顯示兩性趨勢一致：體重過輕顯著增加男性（aHR=1.70，95% CI=1.63-1.79）與女性（aHR=1.52，95% CI=1.45-1.60）之死亡率，而過重與肥胖在兩性中皆為保護因子（所有p<0.05）。

結論：這些發現顯示CRC患者之BMI與死亡率間有顯著關聯。體重過輕使死亡率增加，而過重或肥胖則與男女兩性存活改善相關。

papers.title: Anticancer properties of ethanolic extract of Omani Ocimum basilicum in HCT116 colorectal cancer cells
papers.authors: Al-Mutaani J, Zorgui T, Zourgui L, Alqawi O, Missaoui N
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Natural plant-derived compounds are increasingly explored as safer alternatives to chemotherapy due to their multi-targeted anticancer properties. Despite Oman's rich floral biodiversity, data on the anticancer potential of its native species remain limited. Ocimum basilicum has emerged as a plant with promising bioactivities.
AIM: This study examined the cytotoxic, antimigratory, and antiadhesive effects of O. basilicum ethanolic extract on HCT116 colorectal cancer (CRC) cells.
METHODS: Ocimum basilicum collected from South Al Sharqiyah, Oman, was ethanol-extracted and tested against HCT116 cells at concentrations of 0-200 µg/ml. Cytotoxicity was evaluated using the 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide (MTT) assay, whereas cell adhesion and migration were assessed using fibrinogen/fibronectin-coated matrices and the wound-healing assay, respectively.Data were analyzed using one-way analysis of variance.
RESULTS: The ethanolic extract was rich in1,3-di-O-caffeoylquinic acid (23,366 ppm), rosmarinic acid (3,808 ppm), rutin (2,379 ppm), and luteolin (1,196 ppm).The extract significantly reduced HCT116 cell viability in a dose-dependent manner,from 87.7% at 50 µg/ml to 32.4% at 200 µg/ml (p < 0.0001). Migration was moderately inhibited at 50 µg/ml and strongly suppressed at concentrations ≥ 100 µg/ml (p < 0.0001), while adhesion remained unaffectedat 50 µg/ml but was significantly decreased at higher concentrations (p < 0.0001). A strong dose-response correlation was observed across all assays (R² > 0.89).
CONCLUSION: Ocimum basilicum ethanolic extract exhibits pronounced cytotoxic and antimigratory activities against HCT116 CRC cells, highlighting its potential as a natural anticancer candidate.
