papers.abstract_zh: 背景：天然植物衍生化合物因具有多靶點抗癌特性，逐漸被視為化療的較安全替代選項。儘管阿曼具有豐富的植物多樣性，其原生物種的抗癌潛力資料仍有限。羅勒（Ocimum basilicum）已被證實具有多種生物活性。目的：本研究檢視羅勒乙醇萃取物對HCT116大腸直腸癌（CRC）細胞之細胞毒性、抗遷移及抗貼附作用。方法：羅勒採集自阿曼南夏基亞地區，經乙醇萃取後，以0-200 µg/ml的濃度測試對HCT116細胞的作用。細胞毒性以MTT法評估，細胞貼附以纖維蛋白原/纖連蛋白包覆基質評估，細胞遷移以傷口癒合試驗評估。數據以單因子變異數分析進行統計。結果：乙醇萃取物富含1,3-二-O-咖啡酰奎寧酸（23,366 ppm）、迷迭香酸（3,808 ppm）、蘆丁（2,379 ppm）及木犀草素（1,196 ppm）。萃取物以劇量依賴方式顯著降低HCT116細胞存活率，由50 µg/ml時的87.7%降至200 µg/ml時的32.4%（p<0.0001）。細胞遷移在50 µg/ml時受到中度抑制，在≥100 µg/ml時受到強烈抑制（p<0.0001）；細胞貼附在50 µg/ml時未受影響，但在較高濃度時顯著降低（p<0.0001）。所有試驗均觀察到強烈的劇量反應相關性（R² > 0.89）。結論：羅勒乙醇萃取物對HCT116大腸直腸癌細胞展現明顯的細胞毒性及抗遷移活性，顯示其作為天然抗癌候選物的潛力。

papers.title: Characterizing Sleep and Physical Activity Patterns Among Adults in Puerto Rico with Inflammatory Bowel Disease
papers.authors: Ramírez-Marrero F, Jao Y, Díaz-Mayor D, Torres E
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Physical inactivity and sleep disturbances can affect health and quality of life in people with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). This study aimed to describe physical activity (PA) and sleep characteristics in adults with IBD in Puerto Rico.
METHODS: Forty-eight participants (24 women, 24 men; mean age, 42.1 ± 14.1 years), 73% with Crohn's disease (CD) and 27% with ulcerative colitis (UC), completed anthropometric measures and wore an accelerometer on the non-dominant wrist for 7 days to assess PA and sleep characteristics. The Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index and the Inflammatory Bowel Disease Questionnaire were also used in a subsample(n = 43).
RESULTS: On average, patients with IBD met PA recommendations (≥150 min/week) but had short sleep duration. Patients with CD were significantly younger than patients with UC, but no differences were found in PA, body mass index (BMI), or sleep duration. Men were taller and heavier than women, but BMI, PA, and sleep characteristics were similar, except that men had more sleep interruptions. Physical activity peaked in the afternoon and evening. No significant correlations were found between PA and sleep quality. However, sleep duration was inversely correlated with BMI, and PA was positively correlated with BMI.
CONCLUSION: Patients with IBD were generally overweight and physically active and had short sleep duration. Monitoring PA, sleep, and BMI may inform targeted health interventions in this population.

papers.title_zh: 描述波多黎各成年發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者之睡眠與身體活動模式
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：身體活動不足與睡眠障礙可能影響發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者之健康與生活品質。本研究旨在描述波多黎各成年IBD患者之身體活動（PA）與睡眠特徵。方法：48名參與者（24名女性、24名男性；平均年齡42.1±14.1歲），其中73%為克隆氏症（CD）、27%為潰瘍性大腸炎（UC），完成人體測量並於非慣用手腕佩戴加速度計7天以評估PA與睡眠特徵。部分受試者（n=43）亦完成匹茲堡睡眠品質指數與發炎性腸道疾病問卷。結果：平均而言，IBD患者達到PA建議量（每週≥150分鐘），但睡眠時間偏短。CD患者顯著較UC患者年輕，但PA、身體質量指數（BMI）或睡眠時間無差異。男性身高與體重較女性高，但BMI、PA與睡眠特徵相似，除男性睡眠中斷次數較多。身體活動高峰出現在下午與晚間。PA與睡眠品質無顯著相關。然而，睡眠時間與BMI呈負相關，PA與BMI呈正相關。結論：IBD患者整體偏重且身體活動量足夠，但睡眠時間偏短。監測PA、睡眠與BMI可能有助於此族群之針對性健康介入。

papers.title: Integrating stemness and epithelial-mesenchymal transition signatures with machine learning identifies RUNX1 as a therapeutic vulnerability in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Padubidri S, Singh M, Dehury B
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CC) arises from a complex interplay between genetic and epigenetic alterations within the colorectal mucosa, resulting in unchecked cellular proliferation and tumor development. This complexity results in diverse clinical presentations and varying responses to treatment, highlighting the critical need for personalized therapeutic approaches. The epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) plays a pivotal role in CC progression, but its molecular complexity and therapeutic vulnerabilities remain poorly defined at single-cell resolution. Here, we analyzed single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) data from 42,535 CC cells to characterize EMT states, stemness, and copy number variations. We identified 3,421 hybrid EMT-state cells with high stemness and employed AI/ML models to uncover key transcription factors (TFs). Among 38,606 genes screened, 4,261 were differentially expressed, where CytoTRACE2 and GSVA confirmed stemness enrichment in hybrid EMT cells. Using a deep learning model, scVAEDer, we prioritized 40 master regulatory genes, followed by GENIE3-based TF network analysis, revealing 52 TFs,15 of which regulated more than 5 target genes and were linked to CC progression via diverse pathways. Protein-protein interaction analysis highlighted RUNX1 and SOX4 as central hubs, but RUNX1 emerged as the superior druggable target due to SOX4's poor survival association. To assess the druggability, we performed high-throughput screening of Enamine diversity library's HLL, comprising of 4,60,160 compounds using Schrödinger virtual screening workflow against RUNX1 and molecular dynamics simulations of 500 ns to assess the structural stability and dynamics of screened compounds. Among the top-scoring molecules, compounds Z3687059578 and Z3133469179 displayed stable, strong interactions with RUNX1's DNA binding site, with Z3133469179 emerging as a particularly promising inhibitor. Compared with conventional transcriptomic target-discovery approaches, our integrative single-cell and AI-guided framework simultaneously captures tumor heterogeneity, enabling more comprehensive therapeutic target prioritization in cancer. Our findings establish RUNX1 as a novel druggable TF in EMT-driven CC and propose the identified small molecule for further preclinical validation. Overall, our integrative approach combining single-cell genomics and AI-guided target discovery, and computational drug screening offers a novel framework for identifying therapeutic vulnerabilities in heterogeneous CC.
papers.title_zh: 整合幹性與上皮間質轉化（EMT）特徵並運用機器學習，鑑定RUNX1為大腸直腸癌的治療脆弱點
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CC）源於大腸黏膜內基因與表觀遺傳變異的複雜交互作用，導致細胞增殖失控與腫瘤發展。此複雜性造成多樣的臨床表現與治療反應差異，凸顯個人化治療策略的迫切需求。上皮間質轉化（EMT）在大腸直腸癌進展中扮演關鍵角色，但其分子複雜性與治療脆弱點在單細胞解析度下仍未被充分定義。本研究分析了來自42,535個大腸直腸癌細胞的單細胞RNA測序（scRNA-seq）數據，以描述EMT狀態、幹性及拷貝數變異。我們鑑定出3,421個具高幹性的混合型EMT狀態細胞，並運用AI/ML模型找出關鍵轉錄因子（TFs）。在篩選的38,606個基因中，4,261個呈差異表達，CytoTRACE2與GSVA證實混合型EMT細胞中幹性富集。使用深度學習模型scVAEDer，我們優先排序出40個主要調控基因，接續進行GENIE3基礎的TF網絡分析，揭示52個TFs，其中15個調控超過5個目標基因並經多元路徑與大腸直腸癌進展相關聯。蛋白質-蛋白質交互作用分析顯示RUNX1與SOX4為中心樞紐，但由於SOX4與存活的不良關聯，RUNX1成為更優越的可成藥靶點。為評估其可成藥性，我們針對RUNX1進行了Enamine多樣性庫HLL（含460,160個化合物）的高通量篩選，使用Schrödinger虛擬篩選工作流程，並對篩選出的化合物進行500納秒分子動力學模擬以評估結構穩定性與動態變化。在高分候選分子中，化合物Z3687059578與Z3133469179與RUNX1的DNA結合位點展現穩定且強力的交互作用，其中Z3133469179成為特別具潛力的抑制劑。相較於傳統轉錄組學靶點發現方法，我們的整合式單細胞與AI引導框架能同時捕捉腫瘤異質性，使癌症治療靶點的優先排序更為全面。我們的研究結果確立RUNX1為EMT驅動大腸直腸癌中一個新的可成藥轉錄因子，並提出所鑑定的小分子供進一步臨床前驗證。總體而言，我們結合單細胞基因組學、AI引導靶點發現與計算藥物篩選的整合方法，為異質性大腸直腸癌中鑑定治療脆弱點提供了一個新框架。

papers.title: Beta-site Amyloid Precursor Protein Cleaving Enzyme 1 Overexpression Abrogates ST6GAL1 Mediated Rectal Cancer Chemoradiation Resistance
papers.authors: Beamon T, Mohammed E, Lever J, Irwin R, Somasundaram V, Huang F
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND/AIM: Sialyltransferase ST6GAL1 is known to be upregulated in various cancer types, including rectal cancer, and is linked to poor prognosis. This enzyme catalyzes the addition of sialic acids to various proteins, altering their activity and function. Our lab has previously shown that ST6GAL1 causes resistance to chemoradiation therapy (CRT) in rectal cancer, via sialylation of tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 (TNFR1). This leads to decreased TNFR1 mediated cell death/apoptosis. We aimed to elucidate whether beta-site amyloid precursor protein cleaving enzyme 1 (BACE1), which cleaves ST6GAL1, has a role in treatment response to CRT and whether its overexpression (OE) could improve response to CRT.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We first assessed BACE1 and ST6GAL1 in pre-treatment biopsies from rectal cancer patients. We then evaluated the effects of BACE1 modulation in CRC cell lines. The high BACE1-expressing CRC cell line SW1463 was utilized for inhibition studies, and SW620 CRC cells lines were additionally lentivirally transfected for OE of BACE1 (validated by flow cytometry, qPCR, Western Blotting, and activity assay). BACE1 OE cells were also utilized for response to CRT.
RESULTS: Analysis of patient biopsies showed that BACE1 mRNA was significantly increased in patients with a complete response to CRT. SW1463 colorectal cancer cells treated with a BACE1 inhibitor had increased cell-surface sialylation and increased survival after CRT compared to vehicle-treated cells. BACE1 overexpressing SW620 CRC clones exhibited protein expression and activity of BACE1, with reduced ST6GAL1 protein. BACE1 OE colorectal cancer cells also had significantly increased apoptosis and decreased survival after CRT. BACE1 OE clones had decreased sialylation of the apoptosis receptor, TNFR1.
CONCLUSION: Collectively, we found that overexpressing BACE1 altered ST6GAL1-mediated CRT resistance in CRC cells. BACE1 enzymatic cleavage of ST6GAL1 may be a potential target for improving therapeutic response to CRT in rectal cancer.

papers.title_zh: Beta位點類澱粉前驅蛋白裂解酶1（BACE1）過度表現可消除ST6GAL1所媒介的直腸癌化學放療抗性
papers.abstract_zh:
背景/目的：唾液酸轉移酶ST6GAL1已知在多種癌症（包括直腸癌）中上調，並與不良預後相關。此酵素催化唾液酸加至多種蛋白質上，改變其活性與功能。本實驗室先前已證實，ST6GAL1會透過對腫瘤壞死因子受體1（TNFR1）的唾液酸化作用，導致直腸癌對化學放療（CRT）產生抗性，此機轉會降低TNFR1媒介的細胞死亡/凋亡。本研究旨在闡明可裂解ST6GAL1的beta位點類澱粉前驅蛋白裂解酶1（BACE1）在CRT治療反應中的角色，以及其過度表現（OE）是否能改善CRT反應。

方法：我們首先評估直腸癌患者治療前活體切片中BACE1與ST6GAL1的表現。接著在大腸直腸癌（CRC）細胞株中評估調控BACE1的效果。使用高BACE1表現的CRC細胞株SW1463進行抑制實驗，並將SW620 CRC細胞株以慢病毒轉染建立BACE1過度表現株（以流式細胞儀、qPCR、西方點墨法及活性檢測驗證）。BACE1過度表現細胞株亦用於評估CRT反應。

結果：患者活體切片分析顯示，對CRT達完全反應的患者，其BACE1 mRNA顯著較高。以BACE1抑制劑處理的SW1463大腸直腸癌細胞，相較於載體對照組，在CRT後表現出增加的細胞表面唾液酸化及增加的存活率。過度表現BACE1的SW620 CRC細胞株株呈現BACE1蛋白表現與活性，且ST6GAL1蛋白減少。BACE1過度表現的大腸直腸癌細胞在CRT後亦顯著增加凋亡並降低存活率。BACE1過度表現株之凋亡受體TNFR1唾液酸化程度降低。

結論：整體而言，我們發現過度表現BACE1可改變ST6GAL1媒介的CRT抗性於CRC細胞中。BACE1對ST6GAL1的酵素裂解作用，可能是改善直腸癌CRT治療反應的潛在治療靶點。
